plugins.readme_text:
# 抓虾 Office 插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Word / PowerPoint 文档

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

`dsh-crawshrimp-office` 是一个独立的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Office 文档插件，面向本地、可复核的小型 Word 和 PowerPoint 工作流。它可以生成真实的 `.docx` 和 `.pptx` 文件，将有界 Markdown 转换为 DOCX，读取 Word 与逐页 PowerPoint 文本，检查 OOXML ZIP 结构，并按预期文本或数量校验文档。

它适合生成会议纪要、周报、简短方案、简单演示文稿和本地文档质量检查。文件留在配置的工作区内，不调用抓虾 API、共享 connector、模型服务或外部网络。

## 快速开始

需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，以及已验证的 DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4`。当前发布标签是 `v0.2.0`，通过 DSH 官方插件加载器从 GitHub 安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile demo add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office#v0.2.0
```

安装后，可以直接让 DSH 完成本地任务，例如：“用 `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` 把这份周报保存为 `reports/weekly.docx`，再用 `crawshrimp_office_validate` 检查它是否包含‘本周总结’。”也可以直接调用工具；示例参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)。

插件默认将 `./crawshrimp-office-output` 作为工作区。启动 profile 前可以指定专用目录：

```bash
export CRAWSHRIMP_OFFICE_WORKSPACE="$HOME/crawshrimp-office-output"
```

`-w` 让 DSH CLI 在 profile workspace 中添加插件。安装器会读取 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并自动加载 `cordis.patch.yml`；需要手动加载 patch 的宿主可以使用 [`examples/cordis.patch.yml`](./examples/cordis.patch.yml)。如果宿主需要直接嵌入插件，请加载完整模块命名空间，让 Cordis 同时注册 `apply` 和工具 schema：

```js
import * as office from 'dsh-crawshrimp-office'

await ctx.plugin(office, { workspaceDir: './crawshrimp-office-output' })
```

## 能力与工具

插件实际注册以下 7 个工具：

| 工具 | 用途 | 审批 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_create` | 用标题、段落和简单字符串表格生成 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_read` | 从现有 DOCX 提取有上限的纯文本。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_create` | 生成标题页以及标题/项目符号页组成的 PPTX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_inspect` | 查看 DOCX/PPTX 的 OOXML ZIP 结构、条目元数据和数量。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_word_from_markdown` | 将有上限的 Markdown 标题、段落、列表和简单表格转换为 DOCX。 | 遵循 DSH 原生权限；完全权限自动执行。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_slides_read` | 读取 PPTX 每一页的有上限纯文本，不解码媒体。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |
| `crawshrimp_office_validate` | 校验 DOCX/PPTX 必需部件及可选的预期文本、表格数或幻灯片数。 | 只读，不需要审批。 |

所有文件名都必须是工作区内的相对路径。插件会解析真实路径，拒绝目录穿越和逃逸到工作区外的符号链接，不覆盖已有输出，并先写临时文件，再以不可覆盖的原子方式落盘。

## 使用示例

生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/brief.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "paragraphs": ["A short, reviewable summary."],
  "tables": [{
    "headers": ["Metric", "Value"],
    "rows": [["Orders", "12"]]
  }]
}
```

用 Markdown 生成 Word 文档：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/weekly.docx",
  "title": "Weekly brief",
  "markdown": "# Weekly brief\n\n- Orders: 12\n- Returns: 1\n\n| Metric | Value |\n| --- | --- |\n| Conversion | 4.2% |"
}
```

生成 PPTX：

```json
{
  "filename": "reports/launch-plan.pptx",
  "title": "Launch plan",
  "slides": [{
    "heading": "Milestones",
    "bullets": ["Design", "Review"]
  }]
}
```

更多参数见 [`examples/word-from-markdown.json`](./examples/word-from-markdown.json)、[`examples/slides-read.json`](./examples/slides-read.json) 和 [`examples/validate.json`](./examples/validate.json)。

Markdown 转换支持标题、段落、有序/无序列表、引用、作为纯文本保留的围栏代码和简单管道表格。行内强调和链接会展平为文本。HTML 会被剥离并返回 warning；图片和媒体语法会保留 alt 文本并返回 warning。插件不会抓取或嵌入外部媒体，也不会执行 HTML；不支持的 Markdown 会在安全范围内保留为纯文本。

`crawshrimp_office_slides_read` 返回 `slideCount` 和每页有上限的文本，只读取 OOXML 文本节点。`crawshrimp_office_validate` 在预期文本或数量不满足时返回 `valid: false`；损坏 ZIP、缺失 OOXML 必需部件、无效 XML 及 DTD/entity 声明会真实返回工具错误。

## 权限与上限

写调用使用宿主的 DSH 原生权限信号。会话同时处于 `danger-full-access` 且原生审批策略为 `never` 时，已有的完全权限授予允许写入，无需重复弹出逐次审批；`ask`、受限模式，或审批/沙箱服务缺失、读取异常时，仍走原生审批路径，只有收到 `allowed-once` 才执行。插件没有单独绕过原生审批的配置项。

默认限制单个输入文件 16 MiB、单个生成文件 16 MiB、Markdown 输入 512 KiB、文本提取 128 KiB；段落、表格、幻灯片、项目符号、Markdown block 和 ZIP 条目也有数量上限。可以通过插件配置中的 `workspaceDir`、`maxInputBytes`、`maxOutputBytes`、`maxTextBytes`、`maxMarkdownBytes` 在限定范围内调整。

## 实际边界

实现范围是 OOXML 包的生成、读取和结构校验。插件不转 PDF/PNG，不运行 LibreOffice，也不执行视觉审查。生成成功结果会返回 `visualReview: "not_rendered"`；只有在另行完成渲染并经过人工或模型检查后，才能描述为视觉已验证。`office_run`、Office COM、宏、公式、图表、媒体解码和任意 Python 执行不属于本包。

示例和测试只使用本地临时文件，不调用模型、商家账号或外部网络服务。该包不编辑已有 Office 文档的任意复杂排版，也不渲染图表或重新计算公式。

## 与其他功能包的关系

当前维护三个可独立安装的功能包：[Browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 负责网页操作、登录态和页面脚本，[Data](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data) 负责记录与表格，Office 负责文档。PDF、标签、模板和渲染归 Office 路线图，0.2.0 尚未实现。

0.2.0 新增 Markdown 转 DOCX、PPTX 逐页文本读取、结构/内容校验，并对齐 DSH 原生完全权限映射。

plugins.description: A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.
plugins.readme_text:
# Agent Office

**Tiny coworkers. Real work.** Watch your DeepSeek Harness agents work in a living pixel office.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · MIT · Zero runtime dependencies · No extra API key

![Animated Agent Office preview — simulated events](docs/demo.gif)

Your agents leave their desks to use tools, queue up when they need approval, and take a breather when a turn finishes. Click a coworker to inspect their activity. Everything in live mode comes from Harness session events.

## Try the office in 10 seconds

Clone this repository and run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office.git
cd dsh-agent-office
node src/demo.mjs
```

Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319**. No install, build step, model, or API key required. Demo mode uses **simulated events** and is visibly labeled. This command previews the UI; it does not connect to a running Harness.

## Connect your actual agents

Requires Node **22.19+** and DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-alpha.4**. This first release deliberately declares only the DSH version whose API was checked. New DSH releases need compatibility verification before widening `engines.dsh`.

From a directory containing the downloaded `dsh-agent-office` folder:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile office add ./dsh-agent-office
dsh --profile office web
```

If the CLI is not globally installed, replace `dsh` with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.4`. Configure your model in the Harness profile as usual. Open **http://127.0.0.1:4319** alongside the Harness UI and start a task. The office logs its URL to the terminal when loaded.

To install into an existing profile, substitute its name for `office`. A server restart is needed after installation. Stop the standalone demo before enabling the plugin: both default to port 4319. The first release is a separate browser dashboard, not an embedded Harness sidebar or an operating-system desktop overlay.

### Source checkout / overlay

Generate an overlay with the absolute module path:

```sh
node scripts/make-patch.mjs > office.local.patch.yml
dsh --profile office web --patch ./office.local.patch.yml
```

The generated YAML uses an absolute path because DSH resolves plugin module paths from the profile. The overlay command works without installing the bundle.

## What's inside

- Original procedural pixel art: focus desks, tool lab, approval corner, sofas, plants, and animated coworkers. No downloaded assets or font services.
- Real event projection for main sessions and subagent sessions. Parent links represent **session lineage**, not inferred conversations.
- Independent pending-tool and approval tracking; parallel requests do not prematurely clear a waiting status.
- Distinct completion, error, blocked, paused, and idle states. “Done” means a turn completed, not that the project passed acceptance tests.
- Clickable roster, activity feed, per-session steps/tool calls/reported tokens, and PNG scene export.
- English / 简体中文, midnight / daylight themes, focus view, mobile layout, and reduced-motion support.
- Reconnecting event stream with an explicit stale-state indicator.
- No model calls, extra API keys, runtime dependencies, telemetry, or changes to the agent loop.

![Desktop preview — simulated events](docs/screenshot.png)

## Configuration

Edit the installed bundle row through your profile overlay:

```yaml
- id: agent-office
  config:
    port: 4320
    maxAgents: 48
    maxEvents: 120
```

| Setting     | Default | Range      | Purpose                                               |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `port`      | 4319    | 1024–65535 | Loopback-only office server                           |
| `maxAgents` | 48      | 1–200      | Tracked sessions; inactive sessions are evicted first |
| `maxEvents` | 120     | 10–500     | In-memory activity history                            |

Up to **12 coworkers are drawn at once**; all tracked sessions remain selectable in the roster. Selecting another session brings it onto the floor. If the tracking cap is full of active sessions, new sessions are ignored until a slot becomes available. Counters cover retained sessions since plugin startup, not lifetime totals. UI feed shows the latest six events.

The port is fixed rather than silently changed. If occupied, the plugin logs an actionable error and leaves Harness running. Change it in your configuration and restart.

## Data and permissions

The office observes `session/event` and `session/disposed` at the profile root. It does not register tools, intercept execution, approve operations, or send data to a third party. Approval happens in the original Harness conversation.

Only session IDs, parent IDs, generated names, the last folder name of the working directory, tool names, lifecycle statuses, timestamps, and reported token counts enter the office projection. Prompts, assistant text, reasoning, tool arguments/results, full paths, and approval explanations are excluded. Displayed text is inserted as text, not HTML.

The HTTP server binds exclusively to `127.0.0.1`, checks Host and Origin, has no write endpoints, and closes on plugin unload. Any process or user with access to this machine's loopback can read the displayed metadata. This version is intended for a trusted local machine, not remote hosting. Do not expose its port publicly.

State is in memory. Existing idle conversations and pre-load history are not imported; a session appears on its next observed event. A restart clears the office. A detached session remains as a paused/terminal entry until eviction. Tasks run in a different Harness process are not visible.

## Development and verification

```sh
node --test
node --check public/app.js
```

Eight dependency-free tests cover concurrent tools/approvals, terminal reasons, bounded history, sensitive-data exclusion, token accounting, HTTP/SSE, host/origin protection, port conflicts, and cleanup. Published Cordis **4.0.5-alpha.2** and DSH SessionStore **0.2.1-alpha.4** were separately used to check real session append → plugin → HTTP state and unload cleanup. A full model-backed DSH end-to-end run has not yet been performed.

Browser checks cover desktop/mobile layouts, SSE updates, selection, both languages, themes, focus, and PNG export. See [verification notes](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Share the little office

The preview GIF and screenshots in `docs/` are ready for a GitHub README or release post. They are labeled demonstrations. Source: [xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office](https://github.com/xx-ytg/dsh-agent-office). This plugin has not been published to npm.

Suggested repository description: **A living pixel office for DeepSeek Harness. Watch real agents think, use tools, and wait for you.**

Suggested GitHub topics: `dsh-plugin`, `deepseek-harness`, `ai-agents`, `pixel-art`, `agent-observability`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Independent community plugin; not an official DeepSeek product.

# dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（二次创作，非原创）

> **本仓库不是原创作品。** 它是桌宠 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT）的**二次创作**，只做一件事：让上游桌宠在 **DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端（Electron 版）** 装上、能启用、可管理。桌宠本体、动画素材、全部玩法与文档都来自上游，版权归原作者。 --- ## 📌 非原创声明 | 内容 | 归属 | | --- | --- | | 桌宠本体、106 段动画与素材、提示词、玩法（待机 / 漫游 / 拖拽抛掷 / 余额 / 碎碎念 / 对话 / 工作状态 / 系统通知 / pet pack） | 上游 **[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)**（MIT） | | 官方桌面端适配层（`adapter/`）、组合包声明、上游产物同步与校验、安装 / 兼容 / 排障文档、测试 | 本仓库（基于上游的二次创作） | `vendor/` 内是上游 npm 发布版 `dsh-pet@0.3.7` 的已构建产物，`dsh-pet/assets/` 内是上游的动画与素材——本仓库没有、也不试图拥有上游的任何内容。按上游「二创约定」：任何介绍、展示、分发本仓库的地方，请保留上游作者地址 。 ## 🚀 安装（官方桌面端） 1. 桌面应用 → **插件管理 → 添加插件**； 2. 填本仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop ``` （等价 pnpm spec：`github:zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop`） 3. 启用 `dsh-pet` 组合包，**重开桌面应用**。 默认只显示**一只**：窗口外那只透明置顶小窗（`display: desktop`）。想改成应用内 / 两只 / 不显示，见 [DESKTOP.md §12](DESKTOP.md) 或设置页「桌宠配置」。 ## ✅ 验证 桌宠加载后，DSH 自己的 Web 服务上会多一个只读接口： ```text GET http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-desktop/health ``` 返回 `status: active`、`host.kind: desktop`、`upstream.applied: true` 即适配层与上游都已就绪（字段含义见 [DESKTOP.md §3](DESKTOP.md)）。 ## 📦 仓库结构 ```text adapter/ 适配层：宿主识别、运行时诊断、健康检查、失败降级 cordis.patch.yml 组合包声明（桌面端插件管理据此把它当插件） vendor/dsh-pet-0.3.7/ 上游已构建产物（免构建，SHA-256 逐文件校验） dsh-pet/assets/ 运行时素材（webm / 字体 / 表情包 / 默认配置） animations/webm/ 本仓库额外收录的动作素材（文件名即动作名） tests/ 清单、适配层纯逻辑、启动冒烟 DESKTOP.md 为什么需要、兼容矩阵、排障、版本记录 scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 上游产物同步与可审计补丁 ``` **不在本仓库**（都在上游）：`src/` 源码、素材生成链（提示词 + Python 脚本）、HTTP API 文档、生态清单、玩法与配置手册。 ## 🎞 额外动作 除了上游自带的 106 段动画，本仓库额外收录的动作放在 [`animations/webm/`](animations/README.md)——目录约定与上游一致（`webm/` 子目录 + **文件名即动作名**，VP9-alpha、640×360）： | 文件 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | [`animations/webm/非洲之心.webm`](animations/webm/非洲之心.webm) | 开保险箱、捧起钻石的 10 秒动作（用户自制，已去水印/去音频/抠成透明） | 装法、配置写法与转换参数见 [animations/README.md](animations/README.md)。 ## 🔗 功能、玩法、二次创作 → 去上游 - 功能与配置、动画与 pet pack、HTTP API、问题反馈： - 本仓库改了什么、兼容性与排障：[DESKTOP.md](DESKTOP.md) ## 许可 - 代码：MIT（上游版权归 **PC2005-cloud**；本仓库的适配改动同样以 MIT 提供） - 素材（动画 / 提示词 / 源视频）：允许开源使用，**禁止商用** - 二次创作：请保留上游作者地址 ## 版本 当前 `0.3.7-desktop.5`（基于上游 `dsh-pet@0.3.7`）。变更见 [DESKTOP.md §11](DESKTOP.md)。

plugins.description: A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) client plugin: live account balance plus the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) in the sidebar footer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-balance-chip

**Two rows in the DSH sidebar footer:** your live account balance, and the current DeepSeek billing window (peak / off-peak) with the clock time that window ends.

[中文说明](README.zh.md) · [Agent install guide](AGENT-INSTALL.md) · [MIT License](LICENSE)

```
┌─ sidebar footer ─────────────────┐
│  Balance                  ¥12.34 │  ← balance row
│  Off-peak          ends 09:00    │  ← billing-window row
│  🟣 account                      │  ← built-in account entry
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

The balance row sits directly above the avatar / account row, the billing row right under it. Both register in the `sidebar.footer.action` list slot, so nothing in the built-in UI is replaced or wrapped.

> Why not inside the avatar row: that row is `settings.trigger`, a `single` slot already owned by `dsh-client-ui-settings-general`. `sidebar.footer.action` is the nearest free list slot in the same bottom-left block.

## What it shows

| | |
|---|---|
| **Balance** | Live wallet total from the same `account` Remote that Settings → Account uses. Bonus wallets are appended as `+¥0.50`; amounts truncate to cents with thousands separators; sub-cent amounts show `<¥0.01`. A failed read keeps the last number instead of blanking the row. |
| **Billing window** | `Peak` (amber) or `Off-peak` (green), plus when it ends — `12:00`, `tomorrow 09:00`, `Mon 09:00`, `Mar 3 09:00`. |
| **Hover** | Three short lines: state + countdown, the reason (peak windows / weekend / statutory holiday), then the pricing note and what a click does. |
| **Click** | Balance row opens your usage page (URL comes from the account state stream). Billing row opens the official pricing page. |
| **Collapsed sidebar** | Balance shows only the amount; billing shows only `Peak` / `Idle`. |

Every state renders something visible — loading `…`, signed out, no wallet, read failure — so "the plugin did not load" and "the plugin loaded but has no data" never look the same.

## Billing windows

The billing row mirrors DeepSeek's published rule, **in Beijing time (UTC+8)**:

- **Peak:** Monday–Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, **excluding Chinese statutory holidays**.
- **Off-peak:** everything else — 12:00–14:00, after 18:00, weekends, and holidays all day.
- Off-peak pricing is half of peak.

Sources: [Model & Pricing (EN)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) · [模型 & 价格 (中文)](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/) · 2026 holiday dates from [国务院办公厅关于 2026 年部分节假日安排的通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm) (国办发明电〔2025〕7号). Pricing and windows can change — the official page is authoritative.

The judgement is pure local arithmetic (`Date.now()` plus the rule above), computed entirely in Beijing wall-clock time, so the result does **not** depend on the machine's time zone. On a machine outside UTC+8, the row prefixes `Beijing ` and the hover adds the local equivalent.

The statutory holiday table is compiled in (`lib/client.js`, `HOLIDAY_TABLE`) and currently covers 2026. Weekends moved to working days still count as weekends, so no separate adjustment table is needed. For a year the table does not cover yet, the plugin falls back to weekday-only rules and says so in the hover.

## Install

Requirements: DSH 0.2.x. The plugin panel route is recommended and needs no Python; the installer script below is an optional legacy path.

### From the plugin panel (recommended)

This package is an ordinary DSH npm plugin, recognised by DSH's plugin manager as a profile bundle:

1. Open the **Plugins** panel → **Add plugin** → **Install third-party plugin**
2. Enter any of:
   - `dsh-balance-chip` — once published to npm
   - the absolute path of a checkout, e.g. `C:\Users\you\GitHub\dsh-balance-chip`
   - the absolute path of the packed tarball, e.g. `C:\Users\you\Downloads\dsh-balance-chip-1.2.0.tgz`
3. Refresh or restart DSH when prompted.

DSH records the package in that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the `insert` entry in this package's `cordis.patch.yml` registers `balance-chip` — no profile file needs hand editing. A directory install is recorded as a link, so keep the source directory; a `.tgz` install is unpacked into place and survives deleting the tarball.

### Let an agent do it

Hand the repository, or the release zip, to your assistant and point it at [`AGENT-INSTALL.md`](AGENT-INSTALL.md). That guide covers environment checks, offline verification, installation, activation, reporting back, troubleshooting, rollback, and a no-Python manual path.

### By hand (legacy)

Needs Python 3. This path copies the package into `node_modules` and edits the profile's patch without declaring the package as a profile dependency: a later plugin-panel install runs pnpm, which prunes it as an extraneous package (moved into `node_modules/.ignored/`) and the plugin silently disappears. Prefer the plugin panel above.

```bash
python3 install.py          # macOS / Linux
python install.py           # Windows
```

The installer scans `$DSH_HOME/profiles/*` (default `~/.dsh/profiles`), copies four files into `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-balance-chip/`, and appends one `insert` entry to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. It does not touch the profile's `package.json` or `dsh.profile.bundles`, uses no network, and is idempotent.

Useful flags:

```bash
python3 install.py --list           # show detected profiles, change nothing
python3 install.py --profile web    # install into one profile (repeatable)
python3 install.py --uninstall      # remove the entry, keep the package
python3 install.py --purge          # also delete the package directory
```

Then let it take effect: press `Ctrl+R` / `Cmd+R` in the window first; if that is not enough, fully quit and reopen DSH (macOS `⌘Q` — closing the window does not quit the process).

From a release zip: unzip `dsh-balance-chip-<version>.zip`, then run the same command inside it.

## Configuration

Every field of an entry's `config` is optional; an invalid value falls back to the default instead of hiding the row.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: balance-chip
      name: "dsh-balance-chip"
      config:
        windows: ["09:00-12:00", "14:00-18:00"]   # Beijing time; [[540,720],[840,1080]] also accepted
        weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                 # days treated as working days (0 = Sunday)
        holidays: ["2027-01-01", "2027-02-06"]    # extra dates, union with the built-in table
        ignoreHolidays: false                     # true = ignore holidays entirely
        zoneOffsetMinutes: 480                    # time zone the rule is defined in
        pricingUrl: "https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing"
```

## How it works

- **Two client rows, one host stub.** `lib/client.js` is the browser half: it renders both rows, reads the balance over the existing `account` Remote (`getBalance` for the value, `watch` for sign-in state and the usage URL) and computes the billing window locally. `lib/index.js` is the host half — it exists because the loader also imports every package on the host side, and it carries only a load probe.
- **One slot, ordered by `order`.** Balance `order: 10`, billing `order: 20`, both in `sidebar.footer.action` (`kind: list`, `scope: root`).
- **Pure function, thin component.** `periodAt` / `describeChip` are side-effect-free and exported as `exports.period`; the component only prints their output. The loader reads `apply` / `inject` and ignores the extra export.
- **No network, no credentials, no host code.** The only outbound action is `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")` on click. The only host-side write is a `/tmp` load probe wrapped in `try/catch`.
- **Theme tokens only.** Colours come from `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so light and dark themes both work.

## Compatibility

Developed against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` with `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.0.4` — the versions that ship with the desktop build it was tested on. The package declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency, so DSH's compatibility gate does not block it; what it needs at runtime is the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and the `slots` / `locale` / `remote.account` servi

plugins.description: DSH 交接鏈面板：把互相交接的對話聚成一條鏈（卡片／編號／面板／HUD／門檻提醒／自動交接）
plugins.readme_text:
# session-chains — 交接鏈面板 for DSH

把「互相交接的對話」自動聚成一條**鏈**：左側欄一張卡片列出每條鏈、每場對話編號，
點一下切過去；快到上下文上限時提醒你交接，設定打開的話連「開新對話＋貼提示詞＋切過去」都自己做完。

> 這是 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/) 的外掛（host 端 `index.mjs` ＋ 瀏覽器端 `client.js`），
> 以 `file://` 掛進 `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`，不改內建側邊欄、不動 profile。

---

## 為什麼要做

拆對話是省 token 最有效的手段（同一條工作線實測可省約 71%），但代價是側邊欄散成一堆看不出關係的對話框。
而「哪幾場是同一條線」其實**已經寫在日誌裡** —— 只差沒有人把它讀出來：

- 接手的那一場，交接提示詞是使用者貼進去的**第一句話**；
- 交出的那一場，同一份文字是**助理產出的**。

兩側都落在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<工作區>/<session>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`。
所以只要提示詞裡有一行 `鏈=<代號>`，兩邊就都認得出來，面板自動分組 —— 不必手動歸類。

## 長什麼樣

| 位置 | 內容 |
|---|---|
| 左側欄卡片 | 每條鏈一列，展開是各場對話（`001`、`002`…），右側三顆：收合／暫停／開面板 |
| 面板（浮層） | 全部鏈、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、四鍵排序（名稱／建立／場次數／最後活動） |
| 置頂／封存（2026-10-19） | **側欄每列右側就有 📌（置頂）與 🗄（封存）**，不必進面板。置頂只在右側顯示圖釘（左側不再加一個）；封存是兩段式（**側欄與面板一致**）：按 🗄 會變成「確定封存？」，再按一次才送，旁邊有「取消」。封存的鏈從卡片收起，面板「封存庫 N」才看得到、也才還原得回去 |
| 輸入框上方 HUD | `本場 320k/210` ＝ 這一場的上下文／請求數，達門檻才變色 |
| ⚙ 設定 | 字級、四組顏色、卡片圖示、HUD 五段開關、**交接門檻**、自動交接 |

> **置頂與封存存在哪**：跟改名同一份 `aliases.json`（`pinned`／`archived` 兩個清單），不是瀏覽器 localStorage，
> 所以換瀏覽器、重開 DSH 都還在；改名之後置頂也跟著走（讀寫時都會過對照表）。
> 封存**不動任何 session 日誌**，只是不在卡片顯示。封存的鏈若又交接出新場次，**留在封存庫**（不會自己跳回卡片）。

## 安裝

需要 DSH（桌面版或 web 版都可以）。兩種裝法，選一種：

**A. 從插件市場／`dsh plugin add`（repo 根目錄就是套件根）**

```bash
# 發佈到 npm 之後：
dsh plugin --profile web add session-chains
# 或直接從 GitHub：
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HildebrandYu/dsh-session-chains
```

**B. 直接掛本機資料夾（開發用，改檔即重載）**

```bash
git clone <this-repo> dsh-session-chains
cd dsh-session-chains

node scripts/install.mjs            # dry-run：只寫 .preview/，讓你先看補丁長什麼樣
node scripts/install.mjs --apply    # 真的掛上（會先備份 $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml）
node scripts/install.mjs --remove --apply   # 整包移除
```

掛好後**重新整理 GUI 一次**就會出現卡片。移除時它會把自己那兩段（插件列＋HMR 監看）一起清掉。

> **套件結構**：`package.json` 在 repo 根（市集與 `dsh plugin add` 只讀這個），裡面宣告
> `dsh.bundle.patch = ./cordis.patch.yml`（沒有這個就無法安裝，只宣告 `dsh.client` 不算）
> 與 `dsh.client.platform = web`；程式本體在 `plugin/`，`exports` 指過去。
> 本機用 file:// 直掛時，載入器會從 `plugin/index.mjs` 往上找到根目錄的 `package.json`。

> `install.mjs` 會寫兩段：`session-chains`（插件本體）與 `session-chains-hmr`（把 `plugin/` 加進 HMR 的監看根目錄，
> 沒有這段改 `index.mjs` 不會生效）。兩段都用哨兵包住，可重複執行。

## 使用

1. **平常**：照常工作。交接過的對話會自己出現在同一條鏈裡。
2. **要交接時**：面板上按「生成交接詞」→ AI 寫交接單與提示詞 → 按「開新對話」自動開＋貼＋送出＋切換。
3. **到門檻**：畫面會跳提醒（warn 可延後 30 分鐘、hard 只能延後 5 分鐘）。
   打開 ⚙ 的「到達門檻自動交接」，hard 會在這一輪結束後**自己**做完上面第 2 步。

## 門檻（預設值與怎麼選）

| 訊號 | 提醒（warn） | 強制（hard） |
|---|---|---|
| 請求數 | ≥ 200 | ≥ 320 |
| 上下文 tokens | ≥ 320k | ≥ 480k |
| 佔模型視窗比例 | ≥ 50% | ≥ 65% |

- **warn 是提示**（只顯示，不動作）；**hard 才是緊急煞車**（設了自動交接才會出手）。
- 預設值是回放 42 場真實對話訂出來的：舊的 80／120、160k／240k 會在 25/42 場觸發
  （觸發時中位還剩 103 步＝一定半路被切）；現在只在 6/42 場觸發，都是 300 步以上或 470k 以上的長場。
- 比例那一列是給**換模型**用的：1M 視窗下幾乎不會先觸發，換成 200k 視窗的模型時它會自動先擋。
- 全部可在 ⚙ 改，或直接改 localStorage 的 `dsh.session-chains.settings`。

## 運作原理（三個判定）

| 訊號 | 規則 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|
| 接手 1 | 第一句話有明確標記 | `鏈=my-project` |
| 接手 2 | 舊式提示詞 | `接續 my-project：讀 …` |
| 接手 3 | 第一句話裡的專案路徑 | `30-CodingSkills/my-project` |
| 交出 | **助理訊息裡「整行就是標記」** | 產出的提示詞那一行 |
| — | 都沒有 → 未標記 | 一般對話 |

「交出」那一條刻意嚴格（行首就是標記）：實測一場正在討論本功能的對話，助理推理裡
`鏈=…` 這種字串出現 23 次（全在行內），寬鬆比對會把一般對話誤認成鏈的起點。

**交接時的鏈代號由面板填好**（2026-10-20 修）：交接指令會直接寫「那一行整行就是
`鏈=<這一場的鏈>`」，不再叫 AI「沿用第一句話的鏈或專案目錄名」；新開的場次也會立刻
歸回同一條鏈。原因是後者會沿用舊代號，再被對照表併到別條鏈 —— 實際事故是
「本地部署測試004 一開始被丟到模擬聲音工程」。

**交接會沿用這一場的模型**（2026-10-20 修）：新對話一律先吃部署預設（例如雲端），所以
面板在建立新對話後、送出第一句**之前**，會把這一場最後選用的模型（日誌裡的
`model/selection`，沒有就退回最後一次請求的設定）選給新對話。

怎麼選：**走宿主路由** `POST /local/session-chains.select-model`（宿主直接呼叫
`sessionController.selectModel`，與 UI 的模型選單同一個方法），成功失敗都回得出原因；
舊宿主沒有這條路時才退回瀏覽器的 `ctx.remote.session.selectModel`。

> 面板標題旁會顯示 `v0.1.7`。改了外掛之後如果數字沒變，就是**頁面還跑舊的 bundle**——
> 按一次重新整理（Cmd+R）再試。

## 測試

```bash
node --test scripts/          # 單元測試（純函式：鏈判定、編號、改名、建議歸鏈）
node scripts/smoke.mjs        # 端到端：在沙箱裡跑 client bundle，檢查面板／卡片／交接流程
node scripts/verify.mjs       # 靜態：manifest、bundle 形式、補丁現況
DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:51714 node scripts/probe.mjs   # 實機：宿主是否已把 bundle 組進 boot graph
```

`scripts/smoke.mjs` 不需要真的 DSH：它自己造假的宿主 API（sessions、workspace、fetch、localStorage），
所以 CI 也能跑。

## 已知限制

- **只支援 DSH**：它讀的是 DSH 自己的 session 日誌格式（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），換宿主就得改 `chains.mjs`。
- **紅點還沒有資料來源**：宿主目前沒有「這一場失敗了」的狀態可讀，所以失敗圓點先留空。
- **手動「交接→新對話」在沒有交接詞時會顯示兩步錯誤**（設計如此：先按「生成交接詞」）。
- 鏈的判定靠提示詞裡的標記；沒用過交接指令的舊對話會落在「未標記」，可在面板上逐一歸鏈。

## 授權

MIT，見 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Force the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-thinking-zh

让 DeepSeek Harness 里模型的**内部思考（reasoning / thinking）使用简体或繁体中文**，并可选择让**最终回复**也使用指定中文。

> 非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 无关。英文说明见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。

## 30 秒看懂

| 你想做的事 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 装完就能用 | 默认简体中文思考，回复跟随用户，不用配置 |
| 确认已生效 | 日志出现 `已启用 — 思考：简体中文 / 回复：跟随用户` |
| 在对话里查状态或切换 | 输入 `/thinking-zh` |
| 思考换繁体 | `config.thinkingLanguage: zh-TW` |
| 让回复也用中文 | `config.replyLanguage: zh-CN` |
| 放宽要求 | `config.mode: prefer` |
| 关掉 | `config.enabled: false` |

## 它做什么

- **思考段落（始终注册）**：要求模型的内部思考与推理使用简体或繁体中文；
  - 代码、命令、路径、API 名、错误原文、专有名词保持原样；
  - 中文推理不得省略步骤、降低严谨度；
  - 用户明确要求换语言时，以用户要求为准。
- **回复段落（可选注册）**：`replyLanguage` 不是 `auto` 时，要求最终回复使用指定中文；
  - 用户明确要求其他语言时仍然以用户为准。
- 只改提示词，不改 DSH 程序文件、不改 UI、不发网络请求。

## 安装

从 npm：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-thinking-zh
```

从本地 tarball：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:/path/to/dsh-thinking-zh-0.2.1.tgz"
```

然后确认 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `"dsh-thinking-zh"`，**完全退出并重开 DSH**（包括托盘图标）。

## 配置

四个字段，全部可选。写错只会回退默认并打一条警告，不会让 DSH 启动失败。

```yaml
- id: dsh-thinking-zh
  name: dsh-thinking-zh
  config:
    enabled: true           # 默认 true
    thinkingLanguage: zh-CN # zh-CN | zh-TW
    replyLanguage: auto     # auto | zh-CN | zh-TW
    mode: strict            # strict | prefer
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 可选值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `true` / `false` | 关闭后不注册任何段落 |
| `thinkingLanguage` | `zh-CN` | `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` | 内部思考语言，繁体同时调整用词 |
| `replyLanguage` | `auto` | `auto` / `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` | `auto` 跟随用户；指定后约束最终回复 |
| `mode` | `strict` | `strict` / `prefer` | `strict` 发现英文思考立即改回；`prefer` 只要求尽量 |

`language` 是 0.2.0 的旧字段，仍然兼容，等价于 `thinkingLanguage`，但会提示弃用。新配置请使用 `thinkingLanguage`。

配置固定时提示词完全稳定，不会在请求之间抖动，也不影响 KV cache。

## 状态命令

在交互式 UI 中：

```text
/thinking-zh                 查看当前状态
/thinking-zh zh-TW           本会话切换为繁体思考
/thinking-zh zh-CN           本会话切换为简体思考
/thinking-zh reply zh-CN     本会话让最终回复使用简体中文
/thinking-zh reply auto      本会话让回复重新跟随用户
/thinking-zh prefer          本会话放宽为 prefer
/thinking-zh strict          本会话切回 strict
/thinking-zh off             本会话关闭
/thinking-zh on              本会话重新启用
/thinking-zh reset           清除本会话所有覆盖
```

这些切换**只影响当前会话**，不改全局配置、不需要重启。底层用 agent 作用域段落遮蔽全局段落，会话结束自动清理。

没有命令服务的环境（如纯 ACP）会自动跳过，不影响提示词。

## 确认生效

日志里出现这一行就说明生效：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 已启用 — 思考：简体中文 / 回复：跟随用户 / 严格模式（order=6000）
```

关闭时：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 配置中已关闭，未注册提示词段落
```

注册失败时会有带修复建议的警告，例如检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有同名段落。

## 与同类插件的区别

以下是 2026-10 的公开信息，竞品可能已更新。对比对象是 npm 和 GitHub 上定位相近的插件。

| 插件 | 思考语言 | 回复语言 | 简/繁 | 严格/宽松 | 会话级切换 | 零运行时依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **dsh-thinking-zh（本插件）** | ✅ | ✅ 可独立开关 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `@tirol/dsh-language-set` | ✅ | ✅ 可独立开关 | 仅中/英 | ❌ | ❌（只有全局命令） | ❌ peer 依赖 |
| `@max-null/dsh-chinese-thinking` | ✅ | ✅ 同一条要求 | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ peer 依赖 |
| `yingjian666/dsh-zh-thinking` | ✅ | ❌ | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| `dsh-reasoning-cn` | ✅ + 翻译 reasoning | ❌ | 仅简中 | ❌ | ❌ | 未核实 |

本插件的差异点：简/繁双语言、`strict`/`prefer` 强度、思考与回复解耦、会话级切换、零运行时依赖、16 个冒烟测试。

## FAQ

**模型偶尔还是用英文思考？**
提示词只能引导，不能强制。保持 `mode: strict`（默认），或在对话里直接要求“用中文思考”。

**改了配置没生效？**
插件配置在启动时读取，改完需要完全退出并重开 DSH。临时切换请用 `/thinking-zh`。

**`/thinking-zh` 切换会改全局配置吗？**
不会。它只注册当前会话的遮蔽段落，`reset` 或会话结束即恢复全局配置。

**支持繁体吗？**
支持 `zh-TW`，用词会一起调整（程式碼 / 檔案 / 使用者）。

**旧配置 `language` 还能用吗？**
能。它等价于 `thinkingLanguage`，但会提示弃用；建议迁移。

**会不会重复注册？**
段落名带命名空间前缀；同一作用域内重复注册会报错，日志会提示检查 `cordis.patch.yml`。

## 卸载

从 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 中删掉 `dsh-thinking-zh`，
再执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH 即可。它不写入任何用户数据。

## 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主插件：配置、日志、两段提示词注册、会话命令 |
| `lib/text.js` | 思考/回复 × 简繁 × 严格/宽松 文本模板 |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | 冒烟测试 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：把自己插入 profile 的组合 |
| `package.json` | 包声明，`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向上面的 patch |
| `README.en.md` | 英文说明 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本记录 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 |

## 安全说明

- 无网络、无文件读写、无子进程、无凭据访问；
- 只新增提示词段落，不覆盖、不删除任何已有段落；
- 段落名带命名空间前缀，避免与其他插件冲突。

## 兼容性

- 只用公开的 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 与可选的 `ctx.commands`，不 import 任何 DSH 内部模块；
- `inject = ['systemPrompt']`：服务不存在时插件静默不激活；
- 固定段落顺序 `6000` / `6001`，不依赖未来可能改动的顺序表；
- 纯 ESM、零运行时依赖、无客户端（client）部分。

plugins.description: Offline/online import-export and migration for DeepSeek Harness: profiles, plugins, skills, hooks, boards
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-portable

**Offline and online export/import for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): pack a whole working DSH home into one `.dshpkg` file and restore it on another machine — no network, no `pnpm install`, no manual path fixing.**

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) · [PUBLISHING](PUBLISHING.md) · [HANDOFF](HANDOFF.md)

---

## Why

Moving a DSH setup between machines is painful for three reasons:

1. A working profile is not one file. It is `profiles/<name>/` plus plugins **with their `node_modules`**, skills, hooks, task boards, storages, `AGENTS.md`, installed runtimes, and session logs.
2. Plugins are installed by pnpm from the network. An air-gapped machine, a locked-down corporate laptop, or a machine behind a dead proxy simply cannot run `dsh plugin add`.
3. Configuration files embed absolute paths (`C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh`, `/home/me/.dsh`) and the profile name, so copying the directory tree produces a DSH that boots with broken plugin paths.

dsh-portable solves all three: it packages a whitelist of roots into a single self-describing archive, refuses to walk outside that whitelist, and on import rewrites the six configuration files that actually contain machine-local paths.

## What goes into a package

| Root | Path | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `profiles/<name>` (config **and** plugin `node_modules`) | always |
| skills | `skills` | always |
| skills-disabled | `skills-disabled` | always |
| hooks | `hooks` | always |
| storages | `storages` | always |
| task boards | task-board / todo-board storage | always |
| browser host | dsh-builtin-browser-host | always |
| agent instructions | `AGENTS.md` | always |
| sessions | session logs | opt-in (`includeSessions`) |
| runtimes | downloaded runtimes | opt-in (`includeRuntimes`) |
| credentials | `.credentials.yaml` | **opt-in, off by default** |
| source maps | `*.map` inside the package | on (`includeSourceMaps`) |
| backups | `*.bak-*` next to config files | off (`includeBackups`) |

Anything not listed is never collected — there is no recursive "copy the whole home directory" step anywhere in the code.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-portable
```

The plugin has to be registered in the profile's own `package.json` — under `dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`. Copying the package directory into `profiles/<profile>/node_modules` by hand looks like it works, until that profile runs `npm install` again: npm treats an undeclared package as extraneous and deletes it, and from then on the panel still renders its cards while every request answers `404`. `dsh plugin add` (or `npm install dsh-portable` inside the profile) writes both halves.

Then open **DSH settings → Portable Migration** (便携迁移). The panel is registered at `settings.section` with order 70, and is bilingual (zh/en) automatically.

Nothing is written to the DSH home until you press a button.

## Using the panel

Six cards:

1. **Export** — pick which optional roots to include, name the file, press Export. Packing runs in a worker thread; the progress bar streams entry counts, and a 20 MB package over ~14 000 entries takes about 3 seconds.
2. **Packages** — every `.dshpkg` under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-portable/exports`, with size, modification time and buttons: Select / Download / Share / Delete (delete asks for confirmation). *Select* marks a package for the Import card below; *Download* streams it to the browser so it can be saved to disk and carried to another machine on a USB stick — the LAN share is only reachable while both machines are on the same network.
3. **Upload** — drag or pick a `.dshpkg` and it is streamed to disk (`.part` then rename) with a live percentage, so a 2 GB package never sits in memory.
4. **Import** — pick merge or replace (the active choice is highlighted), press *Preview* first (zero writes), then *Run import* — which opens an inline confirmation before anything is written. The result is a small key/value summary: applied items, rewritten paths, backup folder and warnings, plus the plugin-list merge (bundles kept from this machine, bundles the package needs but this machine lacks). Restart DSH after the import for the written configuration to take effect.
5. **LAN share** — publish a package as a one-shot download link (`http://<lan-ip>:<port>/d/<token>`). Defaults: **1 download, 60 minutes**, Range/HEAD supported, 410 on expiry or exhaustion. *Copy* puts the link on the clipboard and only reports success when the clipboard really accepted it (a textarea fallback covers plain-HTTP origins). No relay, no cloud, no account.
6. **Backups** — the automatic pre-install backups (`<DSH_HOME>/portable-backups/<stamp>`), newest 5 kept. Each one has **Restore**, which copies its files back over the live tree after first saving the current versions under `<stamp>-pre-restore`. Restart DSH afterwards for the restored files to take effect.

## Screenshots

Taken from the DSH settings panel. The DSH home path and the LAN share link in these images are placeholders.

![Export card and package list](assets/panel-export.png)

![Upload, import, LAN share and backups](assets/panel-import-share.png)

## HTTP API

Base: `/dsh-portable/api`. All responses are JSON except the download route and the uploaded-file streaming route. Authentication reuses the host's `connection.requestRejection` fence (cookie + trusted origin), and falls back to a loopback-only check when that service is absent.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/status` | host info, package counts, active job, share server state |
| GET | `/profiles` | profiles present in this DSH home |
| GET | `/jobs` | recent jobs (export / preview / import) |
| GET | `/jobs/detail?id=` | one job with live progress |
| POST | `/jobs/cancel` | cancel a running job |
| POST | `/export` | start an export |
| GET | `/artifacts` | packages available for import |
| GET | `/artifacts/meta?id=` | manifest of one package |
| GET | `/artifacts/download?id=` | stream a package to the browser as an attachment (save it to disk; `HEAD` returns the headers only) |
| POST | `/artifacts/delete` | delete a package (confirmed in the UI) |
| PUT | `/upload/<name>` | stream an uploaded package to disk |
| POST | `/import/preview` | two-phase install, phase 1 (zero writes) |
| POST | `/import` | two-phase install, phase 2 (`confirm:true` required) |
| GET | `/backups` | automatic pre-install backups |
| POST | `/backups/restore` | copy one backup back over the live tree (current files saved first) |
| POST | `/share` | mint a one-shot LAN download link |
| GET | `/share` | list live links |
| POST | `/share/remove` | revoke a link |

**Everywhere a package is named, the API takes an `artifactId` such as `exports:machine-20261018.dshpkg`, never a filesystem path.** `/`, `\\`, `..` and control characters are rejected, so neither the model nor a web page can use this plugin to read or write an arbitrary file.

## Model tools

Registered on the host tools service (silently skipped if the service is absent):

| Tool | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `portable_export` | package the current profile; returns id, size, entry count, per-root breakdown |
| `portable_inspect` | read a package manifest without importing |
| `portable_import` | **without `confirm:true` it is a dry run**; with it, performs the two-phase install |
| `portable_share` | mint a one-shot LAN link (1 download, 60 min) |

## CLI bootstrap (target machine without DSH)

```bash
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 preview .\machine.dshpkg
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 install .\machine.dshpkg --yes

# macOS / Linux
sh bootstrap/install.sh preview ./machine.dshpkg
sh bootstrap/install.sh install ./machine.dshpkg --yes
```

Flags: `--home <dir>` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--profile <name>`, `--mode merge|replace`, `--keep <n>`, `--yes`. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure, `2` usage error. Without `--yes` on a non-TTY it refuses to write.

## Package format

`.dshpkg` is a gzipped tar. The manifest is the **first** entry:

```text
.dsh-portable/manifest.j

plugins.description: A DSH plugin: collect pending ask_user_question prompts from other sessions and answer them without leaving the current one.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sideask

See and answer `ask_user_question` prompts from other DSH sessions, without leaving the one you are in.

**Powered by [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)** — a plugin, not a fork.

[中文说明](README.zh.md)

## The problem

DSH renders an `ask_user_question` card only in the session that asked it. If you are working in session B while session A is blocked on a question, you cannot see it. Your choices are to switch sessions and hunt for it, or to leave the asking agent waiting.

## What this plugin does

- Collects pending questions from every session in the workspace.
- Shows a small **待答 N** counter in the sidebar footer. It is not rendered at all when nothing is pending.
- Opens a compact panel at the bottom-left corner when clicked: one card per session, showing the session title, the question, its options, and a free-text field.
- Submits the answer back to the asking session through `userQuestions.answer`.

The panel never takes over the composer, never steals focus, and never covers the center of the page.

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0` or later.
- **`ask_user_question` must run in `timed` mode.**

That last point matters. In the default `blocking` mode, a question stays in a foreground wait that only the card in the asking session can settle. This plugin cannot answer it — no external interface can. In `timed` mode the wait expires, the tool returns `pending`, and the question becomes *continued*: still answerable, but no longer owned by one interface. That is the state this plugin picks up.

Configure it on the `tool-ask-user` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: tool-ask-user
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
  config:
    mode: timed
    timeout: 60
```

With that in place, a question becomes answerable from this panel after `timeout` seconds. The tool also accepts a per-call `timeout` argument, so a caller that wants it faster can pass a smaller number.

## Install

1. Put the package under your profile's plugin directory, for example
   `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-sideask`.
2. Link it into the profile's `node_modules/@local` under a name that matches the package name:

   ```powershell
   New-Item -ItemType Junction `
     -Path  "$HOME\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\@local\dsh-sideask" `
     -Target "$HOME\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\dsh-sideask"
   ```

3. Add the row to `cordis.patch.yml`:

   ```yaml
   - id: dsh-sideask
     name: '@local/dsh-sideask'
   ```

4. Restart DSH. Client plugins are bundled at boot; reloading the page is not enough.

## How it works

Two halves.

**Host half** (`index.js`) listens to `session/event` globally and keeps a map of pending questions keyed by `sessionId|callId`.

- On `tool/call` named `ask_user_question`, it records the call with its questions and the session's working directory.
- On `tool/result`, it inspects the result: a `pending` reply means the timed wait expired and the question is still answerable, so the record is kept. Any other result means the question was settled, so the record is dropped.
- `turn/end` does not clear records; a continued question outlives the turn that asked it.

Two HTTP routes:

- `GET /dsh-sideask/list?session=<id>` returns the pending questions whose working directory matches the requesting session's, so one workspace stays separate from another.
- `POST /dsh-sideask/answer` with `{ sessionId, callId, answers }` forwards the answer via `ctx.userQuestions.answer(agent, callId, { answers })`.

**Client half** (`client.js`) registers two slots:

- `sidebar.footer.action` — the counter button, hidden when the count is zero.
- `shell.overlay` — the panel, positioned bottom-left, dismissed with × or Esc.

It polls the list route every 4 seconds while the counter is mounted, and refreshes on open.

## Gotchas worth knowing

- `userQuestions.answer` takes `{ answers: [...] }`, not a bare array. A bare array is rejected and returns `false`.
- `stillOpen === true` means the answer was accepted into the agent's queue. `false` means no matching continued question was found.
- A `pending` tool result is not an answer. Treating it as one makes questions disappear from the panel before anyone has answered them.
- After a successful submit, remove the item from the local cache immediately. Waiting for the server to drop it leaves a window where the panel still lists an answered question.

## Known limitations

- Only questions from the same working directory are shown.
- A question that is still inside its foreground wait cannot be answered from here; see Requirements.
- Records live in memory. A DSH restart clears them; questions that are still answerable will not be re-listed until they are asked again.
- Records older than 24 hours are dropped from the list.

## License

MIT

# dsh-starry-sky-theme

A dark-only starry-sky theme for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH) Web UI: a deep-space palette, a slowly twinkling starfield, and faint constellation figures behind the interface.

![Starry Sky icon](./icon.svg)

## Features

- **One sky for both appearance settings.** Light and Dark both resolve to the night sky. The Client half pins the appearance preference to `dark`, so picking *Light* in Settings → Appearance is corrected back to *Dark* while the plugin is enabled.
- **Deep-space palette.** Navy-violet surfaces, moonlit text, and a starlight-blue accent applied as an alias-token layer.
- **Constellation figures.** Four faint star-chart polylines with glowing anchor stars, drawn in the same sky as the twinkling stars.
- **Quiet by design.** The sky sits in the frame-wide click-through overlay: no pointer capture, no layout shift, and it honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Removable.** Disabling the plugin removes the palette layer and the sky in the same HMR pass, and stops pinning the appearance.

## Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (Web UI).
- No extra dependencies: the Client half uses only the `react` module the Harness already provides.

## Install

From the **Plugin Market** (once listed): Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market → Themes, choose *Starry Sky*.

Or install the package into a profile directly:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-starry-sky-theme
```

Then reload the page. The plugin activates immediately; no restart is needed for the Client half.

## Use

- Open Settings → Appearance: the plugin keeps the appearance on **Dark**. The Light choice is available in the stock UI but snaps back while the plugin is enabled.
- To choose Light again, disable the plugin in Settings → Plugins (or remove it). The saved preference stays `dark` until you change it.
- To turn the sky off, disable the plugin; the original palette returns immediately.

## How it works

The Client module registers three things:

1. `theme.overrideTokens('<package id>', tokens)` — an alias-token layer with the dark value repeated for both color schemes, composed over the active theme and removed when the plugin is disposed.
2. A `theme/change` listener that calls `theme.setTheme('dark')` whenever the resolved scheme is light, so both appearance settings stay night.
3. `slots.register('shell.overlay', ...)` — a `pointer-events: none` sky layer rendered above every column. Stars are generated deterministically (seeded PRNG), constellation lines are fixed percentage coordinates, and the twinkle is CSS keyframes (disabled under reduced motion).

No DOM outside the component is touched, no other plugin's styles are read, and no session state is modified.

## License

MIT © 2026 Nektropy

## 中文简介

DeepSeek Harness 的深色星空主题：深空底色、缓慢闪烁的星点，以及四组淡淡的星座连线。浅色与深色外观都被统一为深色——插件启用时会把外观固定在深色，选择「浅色」会被自动改回。关闭插件即移除配色层与星空，并停止固定外观。支持 DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` 的 Web 界面。

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-bilibili-multiview

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏「自动任务」下面增加一个 **bilibili 直播** 页面，以 Niri 风格管理多个直播窗口。

> 仓库名、包 ID、Client 模块 id 与 Host 路由均为 `dsh-bilibili-multiview`；侧边栏显示名保持「bilibili 直播」。

![dsh-bilibili-multiview 预览：Niri 风格多窗口与列内上下分屏](assets/preview.webp)

*4 个窗口 · 3 列；列内上下分屏，直播列表已收起。*

- 直播间列表可折叠：用快捷键切换/移动窗口时自动收起；也可点击播放区左上角按钮展开/收起
- 桌面端折叠 DSH 自身侧边栏时，直播列表自动避让窗口左上角的系统控制按钮；直播列表也折叠时顶部工具条右移避让
- 添加 / 移除直播间、账号 Cookie 设置、封面通过 Host 同源图片代理加载
- 播放区域按 **Niri 水平滚动窗口** 管理：滚轮、← →、Home/End、窗口圆点、底部滚动条
- **列内上下分屏**：把窗口移入相邻列即自动上下堆叠；支持列内上下移动、拆分独立列、整列移动
- 每个窗口独立音量、**Solo 独奏**（`Shift+S`；Solo 跟随焦点，激活时焦点边框变红）、`+` / `-` 调整焦点窗口音量（每次 5%）、画质切换、全屏
- 切换焦点窗口时，其余窗口音量自动降为 **20%**（即降低 80%，Solo 窗口保持原音量）
- 实时弹幕（DANMU_MSG / 礼物 / SC / 舰长），可全局开关
- 直播状态每 30 秒刷新，未开播时显示封面并等待开播

## 安装

### 从 npm

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装 npm 包 `dsh-bilibili-multiview`；如果使用 Agent 工具：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle dsh-bilibili-multiview
```

### 从源码

```bash
git clone git@github.com:Xinrea/dsh-bilibili-multiview.git
```

然后让 DSH Agent 安装本目录（或使用插件管理器）：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle /absolute/path/to/dsh-bilibili-multiview
```

安装后刷新 Web 页面即可在侧边栏看到入口。

## Niri 窗口操作

水平方向是列，列内可以垂直堆叠多个窗口。每个窗口标题栏右侧的移动按钮（四向箭头）打开操作菜单，也可以直接用键盘：

| 操作 | 快捷键 |
| --- | --- |
| 切换列 | `←` / `→`、滚轮、底部滚动条 |
| 切换焦点窗口的 Solo | `Shift+S`（焦点窗口独奏，再按一次取消；Solo 会跟随之后的焦点切换） |
| 调整焦点窗口音量 | `+` / `-`（每次 5%，范围 0–100） |
| 列内切换窗口 | `↑` / `↓` |
| 窗口移入左/右列（自动上下分屏） | `Shift` + `←` / `→` |
| 列内上移/下移窗口 | `Shift` + `↑` / `↓` |
| 拆为左侧/右侧独立列 | `[` / `]` |
| 整列左移/右移 | `Alt` + `Shift` + `←` / `→` |

移动窗口后焦点跟随被移动的窗口；当前列窗口数会显示为标题旁的 `1/2` 标记。Solo 开启后焦点边框变红；切换到另一个窗口时 Solo 自动跟随，关闭当前 Solo 窗口时 Solo 也会转移到新的焦点窗口。任何焦点/移动快捷键都会自动收起直播列表；焦点之外的窗口音量按 20% 播放（降低 80%），标题栏音量滑杆也会以变暗提示。

## Cookie 与隐私

账号 Cookie **只保存在 Host 本机**：

```
$DSH_HOME/bili/cookies.json
```

页面、客户端插件、其它插件都拿不到 Cookie 内容；浏览器只调用同源的
`/bilibili-multiview/api/*` 代理。已有的同名文件会被直接复用。

登录 Cookie 用于账号信息、更高画质和弹幕身份；未设置 Cookie 时仍可匿名观看和
接收弹幕。

## 路由

Host 半在 DSH Web 服务上注册一个前缀路由：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/vendor/mpegts.js` | 本地 mpegts.js 运行时 |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 账号概要 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 校验并保存 Cookie |
| `DELETE /bilibili-multiview/api/session` | 清除 Cookie |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/room` | 添加 / 查询单个直播间 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/rooms` | 批量刷新 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/play` | 获取 FLV 播放地址 |
| `POST /bilibili-multiview/api/danmu` | 获取弹幕 WS 主机与 token（诊断用） |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/danmu/events?room=…` | SSE 弹幕流（页面实际使用） |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/image?u=…` | 封面/关键帧/头像同源代理 |
| `GET /bilibili-multiview/api/stream?u=…` | CDN 拒绝页面 Origin 时的同源回退 |

## 实现说明

- 账号、直播流、弹幕接口参考了 `bili-shadowreplay` 的 Rust 实现，并移植为 Node：
  WBI 签名、`getRoomPlayInfo` 的 FLV 选择、`getDanmuInfo`、zlib/brotli 弹幕包解析。
- Bilibili comet WebSocket 会校验 `Origin`，从 `127.0.0.1` 直连会被 1006 关闭。因此由
  Host 持有上游 WebSocket（Origin 为 `https://live.bilibili.com`），解析后通过同源
  SSE 推送给页面；页面不接触 Cookie、token 或压缩包。
- FLV 优先走同源代理，失败时回退 CDN 直连；封面/关键帧/头像也走 Host 图片代理，
  避免 B 站图片 CDN 对浏览器热链的拒绝。
- 播放器使用 [mpegts.js](https://github.com/xqq/mpegts.js) 1.8.0（Apache-2.0），
  vendored 在 `vendor/`，许可证见 `vendor/mpegts.LICENSE`。
- 弹幕上游连接使用 [ws](https://github.com/websockets/ws) 8.17.1（MIT），vendored 在
  `vendor/ws/`，许可证见 `vendor/ws/LICENSE`。
- 原生只使用 React 与浏览器 API，不依赖 DSH Client 内部 UI 组件；样式全部使用
  `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，跟随明暗主题。

## 开发校验

```bash
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node scripts/host-smoke.mjs      # 真实调用 Bilibili 接口与流代理
node scripts/client-smoke.mjs    # 校验 Client 模块与 Slot 注册
```

`scripts/` 不包含在发布文件列表中，仅供本地调试。

## License

本项目代码采用 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

vendored 第三方运行时：

- `vendor/mpegts.min.js`：Apache-2.0，见 `vendor/mpegts.LICENSE`
- `vendor/ws/`：MIT，见 `vendor/ws/LICENSE`

plugins.description: Wake the agent when a directory changes, with the diff and without the echo of its own writes.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folderwatch

**Wake the agent when the filesystem changes — not when you remember to look.**

An agent can already be woken on a clock (scheduled tasks) and on an HTTP request (webhooks). Neither covers the case that actually matters mid-session: something *outside* the conversation touches a file. A build finishes. A formatter rewrites the tree. A test runner drops a report. A download lands. A colleague pushes into a shared folder. Today the agent finds out only if it happens to look.

`dsh-folderwatch` arms a directory against the agent that armed it. When the tree changes, the agent receives an exact account of what changed — and can either be woken to act on it or simply find it waiting at its next step.

```
[folderwatch] 3 changes under /work/shop/reports
watch: reports · 14:02:11
1 created · 1 modified · 1 deleted
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
(4 events suppressed as this session's own writes)

Read the new report and summarise what failed.
```

## Why it is not just `fs.watch` and a callback

Three decisions separate a watcher you keep armed from one you uninstall after an afternoon:

### 1. Snapshots, not raw events

`fs.watch` reports that *something* happened, not *what*. It double-fires on Windows, sometimes reports no filename at all, and silently drops events under load. A watcher built directly on it tells the agent "something changed" — which is not enough to act on.

This plugin takes **snapshots and diffs them**. Renames, deletions and bursts are classified correctly on every platform, and each change arrives with its size. `fs.watch` is kept only as a *hint to rescan sooner*; the periodic rescan is the correctness path.

### 2. Echo suppression

A watcher on a directory the agent is editing has an obvious failure mode. The agent writes `src/app.ts`, the watcher fires, the agent is told `src/app.ts` changed, it reads the file it just wrote. That one settles — but a build, a formatter or a test runner the agent *itself* started keeps writing, and each write wakes the agent again. The result is a loop that burns tokens and reads as if the workspace were under attack by a stranger.

So tool calls that name a file are recorded in a short-lived ledger, and changes to those paths inside the window are counted as **suppressed** rather than delivered. The window is deliberately short (`echoWindowMs`, default 2500ms): a file the agent wrote ten minutes ago changing *now* is real news.

The suppression is visible rather than silent — every batch reports how many events it filtered, so you can tell "nothing happened" from "the agent did it itself".

### 3. Delivery is opt-in per watch

| mode | call | effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wake` *(default)* | `agent.followup(message)` | starts a new turn |
| `queue` | `agent.inject(message)` | waits for the agent's next step |

A watcher that can always interrupt is a watcher nobody leaves armed. The quieter option is one argument away, so you can arm a watch for a whole session without handing it the power to interrupt you.

## Install

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/11111353535/dsh-folderwatch
```

From a checkout instead of a git host, pass the absolute path:

```
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-folderwatch
```

The package declares no `dsh-*` peer dependency on purpose: it imports only `node:*` plus `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, all of which the harness resolves from its own installation. Nothing is bundled that could shadow the host's copy.

To tune it per profile, add a `config` block to the row the installer inserted in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: folderwatch
      name: 'dsh-folderwatch'
      config:
        quietMs: 400
        cooldownMs: 5000
        watches:
          - path: E:/work/reports
            label: reports
            pattern: '**/*.json'
            prompt: Read the new report and summarise what failed.
            mode: wake
```

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `watches` | `[]` | Watches armed at load time. Arming from a session with the tool is the usual path. |
| `ignore` | build/VCS/dependency dirs | Ignore patterns applied to every watch, merged with each watch's own list. |
| `quietMs` | `400` | Quiet period before a batch is delivered. |
| `maxWaitMs` | `5000` | Ceiling on how long changes may wait for quiet, so a never-quiet tree still reports. |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | Minimum gap between deliveries for one watch. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `1500` | How often the tree is rescanned. |
| `maxWatches` | `16` | Maximum number of simultaneously armed watches. |
| `maxEntries` | `20000` | Snapshot entry cap, guarding against a runaway tree. |
| `echoWindowMs` | `2500` | How long a path stays suppressed after this session writes it. |
| `maxEventsPerMessage` | `60` | Events listed in one notification before truncation. |

## Tools

### `folderwatch_add`

Arm a watch. Returns the arm report, or the reason it could not be armed.

| argument | type | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string *(required)* | Directory to watch. Absolute, or relative to the workspace. |
| `label` | string | Short name shown in listings and notifications. |
| `prompt` | string | Instruction appended to each notification, e.g. `re-run the failing test`. |
| `pattern` | string | Glob selecting which paths are reported, e.g. `**/*.log`. |
| `ignore` | string[] | Extra ignore patterns for this watch. A bare name like `tmp` matches at any depth. |
| `recursive` | boolean | Descend into subdirectories. Defaults to `true`. |
| `once` | boolean | Disarm after the first delivery. Defaults to `false`. |
| `mode` | `"wake"` \| `"queue"` | Delivery mode. Defaults to `wake`. |
| `sessionId` | string | Session to notify, when it is not the calling one. |

```
dsh-folderwatch · armed "reports"
  root:      /work/shop/reports
  watching:  12 file(s), 3 directories (recursive)
  pattern:   **/*.json
  ignoring:  node_modules, .git
  deliver:   wake the agent (followup)

Changes are reported in batches after the tree goes quiet, and this session's own writes are filtered out.
```

### `folderwatch_list`

The inventory: what each watch is watching, how often it has fired, and whether anything is pending.

```
dsh-folderwatch · 2 watches
  reports  running  12 file(s)  2 delivery(ies)  last fired 1m ago
    /work/shop/reports  [**/*.json]
  inbox  stopped  12 file(s)  0 delivery(ies)  never fired
    /work/shop/inbox
    3 change(s) pending delivery
```

### `folderwatch_check`

Rescan now and report what changed **without delivering a message**. This is how you answer "has anything happened yet" during a turn instead of waiting to be woken.

```
dsh-folderwatch · check "reports" · 3 change(s) since the last scan
  + /work/shop/reports/run-42.json  18KB
  ~ /work/shop/reports/latest.json  18KB
  - /work/shop/reports/run-41.json
  (4 further event(s) were this session's own writes)

This was a check: the snapshot advanced and no message was delivered.
```

### `folderwatch_fire`

Deliver a watch's pending changes immediately instead of waiting for the quiet period. Useful to confirm the delivery path works, or when a batch is known to be complete. When nothing is pending, it says so and sends nothing.

### `folderwatch_remove`

Disarm a watch and release its filesystem handles. Reports what it delivered while armed.

```
dsh-folderwatch · disarmed "reports"
  root: /work/shop/reports
  delivered 2 batch(es) over 7 event(s) while armed
  filtered 4 event(s) that were this session's own writes
```

## Slash command

```
/watch                                              # inventory
/watch add ./reports --pattern '**/*.json'          # arm, waking the agent
/watch add ./build --queue                          # arm, waiting for the next step
/watch add ./inbox --once                           # disarm after the first delivery
/watch check reports                                # rescan without delivering
/watch fire reports                                 # deliver now
/watch rm repor

plugins.description: 聊天背景美化：本地图片/视频或预设渐变，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、遮罩、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存浏览器本地
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-chat-background

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

给 DSH Web 界面换背景：**本地图片**、**本地视频**或内置**预设渐变**；右下角悬浮小圆钮点开就是调节面板。

图片和视频只存进浏览器 IndexedDB，设置只写 localStorage，**不发起任何网络请求，也不读取聊天内容**。

## 能调什么

| 控件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 选择图片 / 视频 | 从相册/文件里选 JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF 或 MP4 / WebM / MOV |
| 预设背景 | 晨雾、海盐、蜜桃、青提、夜色、墨岩 6 套渐变 |
| 清晰度 | 0–100%，越低越朦胧（映射到 0–14px 模糊） |
| 背景透明度 | 背景图自身的透明度 |
| 界面不透明度 | 界面底色透出多少背景 |
| 对话栏不透明度 | 输入框卡片与用户气泡的透明程度（默认 90%） |
| 亮度 / 对比度 / 饱和度 | 背景图的色彩调节 |
| 缩放 / 水平位置 / 垂直位置 | 自定义构图，适合人像或大图 |
| 暗色遮罩 | 背景上压一层黑，保证文字可读 |
| 显示方式 | 铺满 / 适应 / 平铺 |
| 动效 | 静态 / 漂浮 / 缓慢呼吸（系统“减少动态效果”时自动关闭） |
| 视频自动播放 | 循环播放；关闭后停在第一帧（省电） |
| 玻璃质感面板 | 侧边栏、卡片、浮层变半透明玻璃 |
| 启用背景美化 | 一键开/关，关闭即恢复原界面 |

右下角圆钮可上下拖动并记住位置；`Esc` 或点面板外关闭；刷新后设置仍在。

## 文件

```
package.json        插件清单：bundle patch + dsh.client（web）
cordis.patch.yml    宿主 Loader 行：id=chat-background
lib/index.js        宿主半边（空 apply，只为占一行）
lib/client.js       浏览器半边：背景层 + 悬浮按钮 + 调节面板（纯 DOM）
```

## 原理

- 浏览器半边在 `body` 里插入四层固定定位元素：壁纸 `#dshbg-image` / 视频 `#dshbg-video`、暗色遮罩 `#dshbg-veil`、界面底色 `#dshbg-tint`，z-index 为负，位于应用内容之下；视频用 `<video muted loop playsinline>`。
- 启用时给 `body` 加 `data-dshbg="on"`，把 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 改成透明，聊天画布就透出壁纸；界面底色由 `#dshbg-tint` 用 `color-mix()` 按“界面不透明度”合成，浅色/深色主题都成立。
- 玻璃模式再覆盖 `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` 与 `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3`。
- 所有 DOM 都在 `ctx.effect` 里挂载，插件停用时会完整移除，不留样式污染。

## 安装

- 仓库放进 `/root/dsh-chat-background`；
- profile 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-chat-background": "link:/root/dsh-chat-background"`，`dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `dsh-chat-background`；
- 建 `node_modules/dsh-chat-background` 链接，重启 Web；页面没出现小圆钮就刷新一次。

## 停用 / 卸载

1. 从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉 `dsh-chat-background`（或在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一条 `disabled: true`）；
2. 重启 Web，之后可删软链与本目录；
3. 想连设置一起清掉：控制台执行 `localStorage.removeItem('dsh-chat-background:state:v1')`，并删除 IndexedDB 库 `dsh-chat-background`。

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web GUI 的搜索插件，挂在内置右侧栏，不依赖 dsh-better-sidebar。 关键词模式搜文件名与文件内容，支持包含/排除 glob、大小写、正则与类型筛选，命中结果边搜边返回； 代码图模式通过 codegraph CLI 查符号并展开调用方/被调方。命中处高亮，点击即在编辑器中跳到该行。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-codegraph-search [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-codegraph-search)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-search) A Search tab for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI's **built-in right sidebar** — no `dsh-better-sidebar` required. One panel, two modes: - **Keyword** — search file **names** and **contents** in the current session's workspace, grouped per file with line numbers. - **Code graph** — query symbols by name / qualified name and expand their callers and callees. Clicking a hit opens the file in the built-in text preview, jumping to the line. ## Modes **Keyword** - File names and content lines; per-file groups with match counts, collapsible. - **Progressive results**: the host streams each file group over NDJSON the moment it is found (`POST /workspace-search/search` with `stream: true`), so hits appear while the walk is still running and the status line counts up live. Rendering is throttled — the first rows show immediately, then the list is updated at most once per 250 ms — so a fast walk never re-renders per file, and the final list is sorted exactly like the buffered response. Code-graph queries stay a single buffered response. - Matched text is highlighted: the query inside file names, matched lines, and code-graph symbol names / signatures, using the same matching rules the search itself used (literal case folding, or the regex and `Aa` state). - VS Code-style filters: **files to include / files to exclude** (comma-separated globs, supports `**`, `*`, `?`, `{a,b}`), `Aa` case toggle, `.*` regex toggle. - Type filter: quick extension chips (`.ts .tsx .js .py .json .md`) plus a free-form extension field. - Skips hidden files/dirs, `.git`, `node_modules`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `dist`, `build`, `.next`, `target`, symlinks, binary files, and files over 1 MiB. **Code graph** - Needs the `codegraph` CLI on the server and a `codegraph init`-ed workspace (the index lives in `.codegraph/`). - Symbol results show kind, signature and location; each row lazily expands callers / callees. Missing CLI, missing index, timeout and parse failures are reported with their own message and a copyable fix command. ## Usage - The panel scopes to the **current session's workspace** automatically. - `Enter` searches; results also refresh ~250 ms after a filter or mode change. - `Esc` clears the query. - Switching tabs no longer re-runs the search: results, scroll position and expansion state are preserved. ## Requirements - dsh web (the built-in right sidebar, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`) - Node.js >= 22 - `codegraph` CLI — only for the code graph mode ## Install Published on npm as [`dsh-codegraph-search`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-codegraph-search): ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-codegraph-search ``` From a local checkout instead — the profile then keeps it as a `link:` dependency, so your edits take effect on the next restart: ```sh git clone https://github.com/Wilyte/dsh-codegraph-search.git dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-codegraph-search ``` Either way the plugin is added to the `web` profile's bundle list, so **restart dsh web** to load it. No extra sidebar plugin is needed: the tab registers directly with dsh's built-in right sidebar, and the sidebar's guide page shows a "Code search" entry. ## Configuration All fields optional (profile patch layer, `id: code-search`): ```yaml - id: code-search config: maxFiles: 5000 # hard cap on files scanned per search maxMatches: 300 # hard cap on total content matches maxLineLength: 300 # hard cap on one reported line maxFileBytes: 1048576 # files above this skip the content scan codegraphBin: codegraph # CLI used by the code graph mode codegraphTimeoutMs: 15000 codegraphMaxResults: 50 ``` Every cap is reported honestly in the status line ("file scan truncated" / "matches truncated") instead of silently dropping results. ## How it works Dual-face bundle. - **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers an HTTP route on dsh's `webServer` (`ctx.webServer.register`, prefix `/workspace-search`) — `POST /workspace-search/search` and `POST /workspace-search/graph`. It deliberately does **not** inject `connection`: that service does not exist in the web host profile. - **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) registers a tab type on `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` (kind `search`), renders its body into the keyed `sidebar.right.pane.tab` seat, and contributes a guide-page entry. Copy is routed through the Client locale service (zh/en) and the stylesheet is mounted through `ctx.effect`, using the GUI's own design tokens. ## Credits This plugin started from [dsh-workspace-search](https://github.com/AmmiWang/dsh-workspace-search) by [AmmiWang](https://github.com/AmmiWang) — the original VS Code-style keyword search tab for dsh, then docked in [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar). The code graph mode, streamed results and the built-in right sidebar were added on top of it. Thanks for the original work. ## License MIT

plugins.description: 鲸歌：让 dsh-pet 跟着 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐逐行显示歌词。QQ 音乐走 Windows SMTC，网易云读本地 cloudmusic.elog（无需 BetterNCM、支持 seek），延迟可调、翻译、桌面悬浮模式不切动画。
plugins.readme_text:
# 鲸歌 · dsh-pet-qqmusic > 让 dsh-pet 跟着 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐，把歌词一句一句唱给你听。 一个 [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：QQ 音乐走 Windows SMTC 读进度，网易云音乐读本地 `cloudmusic.elog`（不需要 BetterNCM / InfLink，支持 seek），按 LRC 时间戳把当前歌词送进 dsh-pet 的对话气泡。播到哪一句，桌宠就显示哪一句。

--- ## 为什么叫「鲸歌」 dsh-pet 是一只住在 DSH 里的蓝鲸。鲸歌是鲸鱼在深海里传得很远的声音；这个插件做的事情很简单——把正在播放的歌，一句一句递到它嘴边。 项目名：**鲸歌**（Whale Song） 包名 / 仓库名：`dsh-pet-qqmusic`（最初只支持 QQ 音乐，现在同时支持 QQ 音乐 / 网易云音乐） --- ## 效果 ```text QQ 音乐 晴天 — 周杰伦 00:29 桌宠气泡 ♪ 故事的小黄花 网易云 熄灭 — TC 01:09 桌宠气泡 ♪ 可不知不觉你的心已越来越远 ``` 歌词会随着播放进度逐行切换。默认带 600ms 提前量，用来抵消 dsh-pet 气泡约 1 秒的状态轮询；觉得快/慢可以直接调。 --- ## 特性 - **双播放器**：QQ 音乐（SMTC）+ 网易云音乐（本地 elog），`player: auto` 自动跟随正在播放的那个 - **网易云无需插件**：直接解析 `cloudmusic.elog`，不需要 BetterNCM / InfLink；能感知播放/暂停和**拖拽 seek** - **逐行同步**：按 LRC 时间戳切行，不靠猜 - **低延迟**：宿主 200ms 采样 + 客户端 300ms 轮询，并按 `nextLine.t` 主动排程下一行；默认 `offsetMs=600` 补偿 dsh-pet 的气泡轮询 - **版本匹配**：按「歌名 + 歌手 + 时长」在曲库挑版本，Live / 伴奏 / 翻唱降权；网易云优先用 songId 直接取词 - **跳过制作名单**：自动去掉开头的「词：/曲：/编曲：/吉他：」和「歌名 - 歌手」标题行 - **纯音乐识别**：返回「此歌曲为没有填词的纯音乐」时显示「纯音乐，请欣赏」，不乱唱 - **翻译可选**：有翻译时，可显示原文 + 译文两行 - **不刷新宠物模型**：web 桌宠用自绘歌词气泡；桌面悬浮模式用一键 quiet 补丁，歌词只更新气泡，不切动画、不重播 - **多桌宠**：`petId` 留空 = 当前桌宠，也可以固定投给某一只 - **零密钥**：不需要 DeepSeek / OpenAI / QQ 音乐 / 网易云的任何 API Key，也不读 Cookie --- ## 前置条件 | 条件 | 说明 | |---|---| | Windows 10 1809+ / Windows 11 | QQ 音乐依赖 Windows SMTC；网易云走本地日志 | | QQ 音乐 PC 客户端 | 建议 ≥ 21.10.2962（更早版本不上报播放进度）；本项目在 22.76 上验证 | | 网易云音乐 PC 客户端 | 建议 3.0+（会写 `cloudmusic.elog`）；本项目在 3.1.39 上验证 | | dsh-pet | 已安装并启用；用到它的 `/dsh-pet-7340/broadcast` 端点，建议 0.3.5+ | | DSH | 桌面版（desktop profile）或 `dsh web` 均可 | ### 开启 QQ 音乐 SMTC QQ 音乐默认不向系统暴露媒体会话。打开： ```text QQ 音乐 → 主菜单（≡）→ 设置 → 常规设置 → 通知 → 勾选「显示系统媒体传输控制（SMTC）」 ``` 不同小版本菜单文案可能略有差异，认准 **SMTC / 系统媒体传输控制**。开启后播放任意歌曲，系统的媒体控制中心应该能看到 QQ 音乐。 ### 网易云音乐：不需要 SMTC 网易云 3.0+ 不会注册新版 SMTC 会话，但会把播放事件写进： ```text %LOCALAPPDATA%\NetEase\CloudMusic\cloudmusic.elog ``` 插件直接读这个日志： - 不需要 BetterNCM / InfLink-rs，不需要注入 DLL - 不需要登录 API，不读 Cookie - 能拿到歌名 / 歌手 / 专辑 / songId / 播放进度 / 暂停状态 / seek 位置 - 只解析上述字段，日志里的 `musicurl`（带签名）不会被读取或上传 只要启动过网易云并播放过一首歌，日志就会存在。如果日志不存在，插件会在桌宠气泡提示。 --- ## 安装 > 没有 git 环境？可以直接从 [Releases](https://github.com/344272586-sketch/dsh-pet-qqmusic/releases/latest) 下载源码包。 ### 方式 A：DSH 桌面应用（desktop profile） DSH 桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 应用独占管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop ...` 会提示 *profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application*，所以本地插件需要手动登记： 1. 把仓库放到一个固定目录，例如 `C:\Plugins\dsh-pet-qqmusic`（下文用 `` 代替）： ```powershell git clone https://github.com/344272586-sketch/dsh-pet-qqmusic.git C:\Plugins\dsh-pet-qqmusic ``` 2. 编辑 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`： - `dependencies` 加一行（JSON 里反斜杠要写成 `\\`）： ```json "dsh-pet-qqmusic": "link:" ``` - `dsh.profile.bundles` 加一项 `"dsh-pet-qqmusic"`； 3. 在 profile 目录用 DSH 自带的 Node / pnpm 安装： ```powershell $profile = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop" $node = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" $pnpm = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs" & $node $pnpm install --dir $profile --config.confirmModulesPurge=false ``` 4. **桌面悬浮模式额外打一次 quiet 补丁**（`display: "desktop"` 时必需；web 模式可跳过）： ```powershell cd & "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" ` scripts\patch-dsh-pet-quiet-lyrics.mjs --restart ``` 5. 刷新 DSH 页面；如果没加载，完全退出 DSH 再打开一次。 ### 方式 B：dsh web（web profile） ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add link: # 发布到 npm 后也可以： # dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-qqmusic ``` 装完重启 `dsh web`，刷新浏览器。 --- ## 配置 用户配置在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-pet-qqmusic/config.json`（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-pet-qqmusic\config.json`）。改完下一轮生效，不需要重启。 | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后浏览器侧不再投喂 | | `petId` | `""` | 目标桌宠 id；空 = dsh-pet 当前桌宠（`/pet` 选中的那只，未选则第一只） | | `player` | `"auto"` | `auto`：谁在播放就用谁；`qq` / `netease` 强制指定播放器（两个客户端同时开时有用） | | `neteasePath` | `""` | 自定义 `cloudmusic.elog` 路径；空 = `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\NetEase\CloudMusic\cloudmusic.elog`（改完需重启插件） | | `displayMode` | `"auto"` | `auto`：web 桌宠用自绘气泡、桌面悬浮回落到投喂；`overlay`：只用自绘气泡（不触发动画，桌面模式不显示）；`bubble`：始终走 `dsh-pet /broadcast` | | `offsetMs` | `600` | 歌词提前量（毫秒），范围 −5000 ~ 5000；正数 = 歌词更早出现。默认 600 是补偿 dsh-pet 气泡约 1 秒的轮询 | | `neteaseOffsetMs` | `null` | 网易云单独提前量；`null` = 跟随 `offsetMs`。QQ 和网易云延迟不同时用（范围同样 −5000 ~ 5000） | | `keepAliveSec` | `8` | 同一行超过 N 秒补发一次，防止气泡 10 秒自动收起；`0` = 不补发 | | `hostFallback` | `true` | DSH 前台被最小化/后台节流时，宿主直接写 dsh-pet，桌面歌词不依赖浏览器轮询；`overlay` 模式不启用 | | `showTrackInfo` | `true` | 切歌时先显示「歌名 - 歌手」 | | `showTranslation` | `false` | 有翻译时显示两行（原文 + 译文） | | `prefix` | `"♪ "` | 气泡前缀，最多 8 字符 | | `hints` | `true` | 没有 SMTC / 没开 QQ 音乐时让桌宠提示（每 10 分钟最多一次） | | `debug` | `false` | 宿主日志开关 | 也可以直接改接口（把 `` 换成你的 DSH 端口）： ```powershell # 读 Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-qqmusic/config.json # 改（只传要改的字段） Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-qqmusic/config.json -Method Put ` -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"offsetMs":800,"showTranslation":true}' ``` ### 延迟调法 - 歌词比声音**快**：把 `offsetMs` 调小（负值） - 歌词比声音**慢**：调大（正值） - 默认 600ms 是给 dsh-pet 气泡轮询的补偿；蓝牙耳机 / 外置声卡常见再 ±200~500ms --- ## 工作原理 ```text QQ 音乐 PC ──SMTC──> smtc-helper.cs（C# / WinRT，首次启动编译） │ title / artist / album / status / position / duration │ 网易云 PC ──cloudmusic.elog──> lib/netease-elog.js（逐字节解码 + 状态机） │ songId / title / artist / album / position / seek / 播放状态 ▼ dsh-pet-qqmusic 宿主（Node） │ 1. player=auto：选正在播放的那个 │ 2. QQ：QQ 曲库搜索 + GetPlayLyricInfo │ 网易云：songId 直接取词（本地缓存 / 公开 API） │ 3. 解析时间戳 / 合并翻译 / 纯音乐识别 / 磁盘缓存 ▼ GET /dsh-pet-qqmusic/state.json（当前行 + 下一行 + 进度） │ ▼ 浏览器侧 lib/client.js（300ms 轮询 + nextLine 主动排程） │ 行变化才发，keepAlive 到点补发 ┌───────────┴────────────┐ ▼ ▼ web 桌宠：自绘歌词气泡 desktop：POST /dsh-pet-7340/broadcast （复用 dsh-pet bubble CSS， （文本前带 U+200B；打过 quiet 补丁的 只改文本，不碰动画） helper 只更新气泡、不切动画） ``` ### 为什么桌面模式要打补丁 dsh-pet 的 `/broadcast` 在桌面 helper 里最终走 `PetSprite.showWhisper()`：它会随机挑一个碎碎念动画并 `playOnce()`。如果每句歌词都直接投喂，宠物模型就会每句换一次动作，看起来像在刷新。 补丁只给 `runtime/electron-helper/events.js` 的 `showWhisper` 加一个分支：带 `U+200B` 标记的投喂只更新气泡，不切动画、不 `playOnce`、不打断移动。普通碎碎念仍走原逻辑。 - **web 桌宠**：不需要补丁，客户端直接画歌词气泡（复用 dsh-pet 的 `.dsh-pet-bubble` 样式） - **桌面悬浮小窗**：需要补丁，因为独立 Electron 窗口没有页面 DOM 可叠 - dsh-pet 升级覆盖 `events.js` 后，重跑一次 `scripts/patch-dsh-pet-quiet-lyrics.mjs --restart` --- ## 调试 | 路由 | 用途 | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-pet-qqmusic/` | 可视化调试面板（1.5 秒自动刷新） | | `GET /dsh-pet-qqmusic/state.json` | 当前完整状态 | | `GET /dsh-pet-qqmusic/health` | helper / 歌词状态 | | `GET/PUT /dsh-pet-qqmusic/config.json` | 读 / 改配置 | | `POST /dsh-pet-qqmusic/refresh` | 强制重新取词（绕过磁盘缓存） | 没有 SMTC 会话时： ```json { "ok": true, "available": false, "qqmusicRunning": true, "hint": { "code": "smtc-off", "text": "QQ音乐没开 SMTC：设置 → 常规设置 → 通知 → 显示系统媒体传输控制（SMTC）" } } ``` ### 自检 SMTC ```powershell & "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-pet-qqmusic\bin\smtc-helper.exe" --any ``` `count > 0` 且 `session` 非空，说明系统 SMTC 正常；再看 `source` 是不是 QQMusic。首次启动会自动从 `lib/smtc-helper.cs` 编译到这个路径。 --- ## 常见问题 **桌宠只显示「QQ音乐没开 SMTC…」** 按上面的路径开启 SMTC；开启后不用重启 DSH，插件下一轮会自己读到。
