plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-leike-pet · 小红帽蕾克桌宠

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）会话窗口加一只像素桌宠：黑童话里的**小红帽蕾克**。
透明背景、无边框、始终置顶，平时在会话窗口底部左右慢悠悠地走动，偶尔停下张望、
蹦一下；鼠标靠近会停下并把头转向你；双击它原地睡着，再双击继续散步；
右键可以打开设置面板把大小调到 2×~7×。

A tiny pixel-art desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness session window — transparent,
borderless, always on top; it strolls along the composer, blinks, looks around,
turns its head toward your cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales 2×–7×.

| 走动 | 靠近你 | 睡觉 | 调大小 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![走动](preview/shots/hero-walk.png) | ![靠近](preview/shots/hero-alert-left.png) | ![睡觉](preview/shots/hero-rest.png) | ![面板](preview/shots/hero-panel.png) |

> 上面的截图来自仓库里的 `preview/index.html`（本地还原 DSH 布局的预览页），
> 用来展示实际渲染效果；插件跑在真实会话窗口里时外观一致。

## 功能

- **透明无边框、始终置顶**：覆盖层 `position:fixed`，只有精灵本体接收鼠标事件，
  不会挡住输入框或消息。
- **在会话窗口里散步**：用 DSH 会话容器的稳定属性
  （`[data-conversation-content]` / `[data-composer-seat]`）测出地面与左右边界，
  在输入框上沿来回走，速度 26px/s；走到边上会掉头，走一会儿随机停下待机。
- **会呼吸的小动作**：
  - 走动时两步一拍的上下起伏（整数像素，不糊边）；
  - 待机时左右张望、偶尔蹦一下；
  - 平时随机眨眼（单独的闭眼帧），睡觉时直接闭眼；
  - 走到边界掉头时先露一下背影，像真的转了个身。
- **鼠标靠近会看你**：鼠标进入头部 220px 半径时停下并切换三向姿势（左 / 正 / 右）；
  鼠标离开或停在原地超过 2.6 秒后继续走动。
- **双击睡觉**：闭眼 + 呼吸起伏 + 头顶 `Zzz`，再双击恢复走动。
- **右键调大小**：面板里 2×~7× 实时缩放，整数倍放大 + `image-rendering:pixelated`，
  任何尺寸像素都不会糊；选择记在 `localStorage`，下次打开还是这个大小。
- **不挑主题**：亮色 / 暗色主题都能看清；面板用深色半透明底，和精灵的像素风一致。

## 安装

### 从 npm（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-leike-pet
```

### 从 GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Zyr147258/dsh-leike-pet
```

### 官方桌面端（Electron 客户端，`desktop` profile）

桌面端 profile 由客户端独占管理，命令行不能直接改。在这个对话里让宿主自带的
`plugin_manager` 装即可：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: link:<本目录绝对路径>
```

或从 npm / GitHub 装同名包。**首次安装后要完全退出客户端（含托盘）再打开**：
桌面端只在宿主启动时收集一次 `index.html` 注入表，插件注册得再早，也要等下一次
启动才会被塞进页面。

### 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Zyr147258/dsh-leike-pet.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
```

装完重启 `dsh web`，浏览器 `Ctrl+F5`。

## 使用

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 什么都不做 | 在会话窗口底部左右缓慢走动，偶尔停下张望 / 蹦一下 / 眨眼 |
| 鼠标靠近 | 停下，头转向鼠标方向；鼠标离开或停住不动约 2.6 秒后继续走 |
| 双击精灵 | 原地睡觉（闭眼 + Zzz），再双击继续走动 |
| 右键精灵 | 打开/关闭设置面板（大小 2×~7×） |
| Esc / 点面板外 | 关闭设置面板 |

想调整手感，改 `lib/pet.js` 顶部的常量（改完刷新页面即生效，不用重启宿主）：

```js
var SPEED = 26              // 走动速度 px/s
var ALERT_RADIUS = 220      // 鼠标靠近多少像素开始转头
var ALERT_HOLD_MS = 2600    // 鼠标停住多久后继续走动
var IDLE_MIN / IDLE_MAX     // 每次停下待机的时长
var WALK_BURST_MIN / MAX    // 连续走多久后随机停一下
var BLINK_MIN / BLINK_MAX   // 眨眼间隔
var LOOK_MIN / LOOK_MAX     // 待机张望间隔
var HOP_CHANCE              // 待机时蹦一下的概率
var SCALE_MIN / SCALE_MAX   // 面板里可调的大小范围（整数倍）
```

## 结构

```text
dsh-leike-pet/
├── package.json                # dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml            # 把 Host 半侧挂进 profile
├── icon.png                    # 插件列表图标
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js                # Host 半侧：/dsh-pet/* 静态资源 + index.html 注入
│   └── pet.js                  # 浏览器半侧：纯 DOM 桌宠（不依赖 React / 客户端插件运行时）
├── assets/
│   ├── frame-front.png         # 正面（待机 / 转头）
│   ├── frame-left.png          # 朝左（走动 / 转头）
│   ├── frame-right.png         # 朝右（left 的镜像）
│   ├── frame-back.png          # 背面（掉头过渡）
│   ├── frame-front-blink.png   # 正面眨眼
│   ├── frame-left-blink.png    # 朝左眨眼（右向由它镜像）
│   ├── frame-right-blink.png   # 朝右眨眼
│   ├── frame-front-sleep.png   # 睡觉（闭眼正面）
│   └── source-sheet.png        # 原始四格立绘
├── preview/index.html          # 本地预览 + 交互自测页（?selftest=1）
└── tools/build_sprites.py      # 从原始立绘重建透明底像素精灵 + 闭眼帧
```

## 精灵图是怎么来的

原始素材是一张 1040×320 的四格立绘（纯色背景）。`tools/build_sprites.py`：

1. 抠掉背景色 `#18141e`；
2. 按 7.25 倍的放大格反采样回 25~27 × 32 的原始像素网格；
3. 按「内容包围盒中心」对齐到共同画布（换姿势时头部不抖）；
4. 输出**原始像素尺寸**（27×32）的 RGBA PNG，前端按整数倍用 CSS 放大——
   这样 2×~7× 任意大小都是正方形的锐利色块，不需要多套图；
5. 闭眼帧：按列把虹膜/眼眶的黑蓝像素换成肤色，再在中间补 2px 的闭眼线；
   右向闭眼直接镜像左向。

想换成自己的角色，替换 `assets/frame-*.png`（保持 27×32 画布、透明底、脚底贴齐
画布下沿）即可。

## 调试

页面里的 `window.__DSH_PET__` 暴露了只读状态与几个手动接口：

```js
__DSH_PET__.state        // 'walk' | 'idle' | 'alert' | 'rest'
__DSH_PET__.pose         // 'front' | 'left' | 'right' | 'back' | 'sleep' | '*Blink'
__DSH_PET__.scale        // 当前大小倍数
__DSH_PET__.position     // { x, floor, minX, maxX, w, h }
__DSH_PET__.rest(true)   // 立刻睡觉
__DSH_PET__.setScale(6)  // 立刻放大到 6×
__DSH_PET__.openPanel()  // 打开设置面板
__DSH_PET__.face(x, y)   // 模拟鼠标位置（触发转头）
__DSH_PET__.step(16)     // 手动推进一帧（无 rAF 环境测试用）
__DSH_PET__.destroy()
```

## 和其它插件的兼容性

- **dsh-whale-widget（小鲸鱼）**：路由（`/dsh-pet/*` vs `/dsh-whale/*`）、全局变量
  （`__DSH_PET_*` vs `__dshWhale*`）、样式节点 id 都不同，两边往 `index.html` 推的注入行
  各自去重，可以同时存在。桌宠会读鲸鱼暴露的 `window.__dshWhaleRoot`，**自动让开它所在的
  角落**（右下角时散步范围在它左边 12px 停下），不会压住鲸鱼、也不会挡它的点击；鲸鱼的
  菜单/弹层 z-index 在 9999~26000+，鲸鱼 toast 在 2147483600，都仍在桌宠之上。
- **dsh-startup-screen（启动画面）**：桌宠 z-index 是 `2147482999`，比启动画面的
  `2147483000` 低一层，开场动画期间会被盖住，不会穿帮；动画结束后自然露出来。
- **dshmarket / 内置界面**：桌宠只加一个 `position:fixed`、`pointer-events:none` 的透明
  覆盖层，只有精灵本体和设置面板接收鼠标事件，不拦截任何界面点击。
- 不写配置文件、不注册 settings 命名空间、不碰宿主状态；唯一持久化的是
  `localStorage['dsh-pet:scale']`（大小偏好），卸载即干净。

## 已知边界

- 这是**应用窗口内**的桌宠，不是系统级桌面宠物（DSH 插件只能活在 Harness 的页面里）。
- 插件只提供静态资源，不读写任何凭据；走动位置等状态都在内存里，刷新即回到初始位置。
- 没有会话窗口时（例如停在设置页），会退化成沿主面板底部走动。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 一键截图：截取 DeepSeek Harness 窗口，PNG 直接作为附件放进输入框草稿 · One-click DSH screenshot: capture the DeepSeek Harness window and drop the PNG straight into the composer draft (Windows/macOS/Linux)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quick-screenshot

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

One-click screenshots of the DeepSeek Harness window, placed straight into the
composer draft.

It is one self-contained DSH bundle: a Host half that captures the DSH window (or
a window / the whole desktop) through the platform's own tooling and serves the
PNG over one authenticated Fetch route, and a hand-written Client half served as
the package's `./client` bundle.

## What it adds

| Seat | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `shell.overlay` | A **floating camera control** over the whole window, so a screenshot works on every page — not only where a composer happens to be mounted. Drag it anywhere; the anchor persists in `localStorage`. |
| `conversation.input.left` | The same control in the composer's left tool row, next to `+` |

| Gesture | Capture target |
| --- | --- |
| Click | The DeepSeek Harness window (largest visible window whose title contains `DeepSeek Harness`, falling back to the foreground window) |
| Shift+click | The whole desktop, every monitor |
| Alt+click | Whatever window is currently in the foreground |
| `Ctrl+Shift+S` | The same as a plain click, from anywhere on the page |

Where the image lands depends on what is on screen: a mounted composer's draft
takes it as an attachment, so the next message carries the image; with no
composer mounted the PNG goes to the clipboard, ready to paste into the
conversation the reader navigates to. A click never steals the keyboard —
`mousedown` is prevented, so the caret stays where it was.

The control reports what happened in place: a spinner while the Host captures,
`已放入输入框` with the captured pixel size for a few seconds afterwards, or the
Host's own refusal text when the capture failed. The tooltip carries the full
gesture list and the last result.

## Where the image goes

With a composer mounted, the Client half follows the path the composer's own
paste and drop intake take:

1. `POST /api/quick-screenshot` returns the PNG bytes (and a small metadata header).
2. `ctx.conversation.createDrafts(sessionId, [file])` registers the browser file
   and returns its draft id.
3. The `inputActions` standard prop admits those ids with
   `addAttachments(ids)` — the composer's rail then shows the thumbnail and the
   send serializes the image with the message.

With no composer mounted (the plugins page, Trajectory, Settings …) the same
capture is written to the system clipboard instead, and the result bubble says
so — paste it into a composer when the reader gets there. If the clipboard
refuses the write, the bubble names the staged PNG on disk instead.

When those services are unavailable, the client falls back to dispatching a
synthetic `paste` event carrying the file on `[data-composer-input="true"]`,
which is exactly what a manual paste does.

## Host route

`GET /api/quick-screenshot` describes what this Host can capture right now
(`supported`, `platform`, `tool`, `modes`, `directory`); `POST /api/quick-screenshot`
takes an optional JSON body and answers with the PNG:

```json
{ "mode": "window", "titlePattern": "DeepSeek Harness", "maxDimension": 0 }
```

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `mode` | `window` (default), `active`, or `screen` |
| `titlePattern` | Window title matched by `window` mode; defaults to `DeepSeek Harness` |
| `maxDimension` | Optional cap on the longest side; `0` keeps the native capture size |

The response is `image/png` with `Cache-Control: no-store` and one
`X-Screenshot` header carrying percent-encoded JSON metadata
(`mode`, `method`, `window`, `width`, `height`, `bytes`, `path`). Failures answer JSON
with a stable `code` (`CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTED`, `CAPTURE_TIMEOUT`, `CAPTURE_FAILED`,
`METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`) and a message meant for the user. Both methods are
registered through `ctx.connection.fetch`, so the shared `/api` bridge applies
Host/Origin validation and browser-cookie authentication before the handler runs.

## Capture backends

| Platform | Tool | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | `powershell.exe` + `System.Drawing` | `PrintWindow(PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT)` first, so an occluded window still captures; a flat result falls back to reading the same rectangle off the screen after raising the window. Per-monitor-v2 DPI aware. |
| macOS | `screencapture -x -o` | Display capture; `window`/`active` both resolve to the active display. |
| Linux | first of `gnome-screenshot`, `spectacle`, `grim`, `import`, `scrot` | Display capture. |

`DSH_SCREENSHOT_POWERSHELL` overrides the Windows shell (useful when only
PowerShell 7 is installed).

Captures are staged in `<tmpdir>/dsh-screenshot/`, and the directory keeps only
its newest 24 files, so the plugin owns no durable state and never grows
unbounded. One capture at a time: concurrent clicks queue instead of racing.

## Install

Run the DSH Plugin Manager's `install_bundle` against this directory (a local
path spec), or add it to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` after installing it
with pnpm. The bundle's patch inserts one row, `id: screenshot`, naming this
package.

From a GitHub checkout, no build step is involved:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JackEngineer/dsh-quick-screenshot
```

## Publishing to the plugin market

The market lists plugins from the curated
[awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
list, not from its own repository — publishing means opening one entry-file PR
there. [`PUBLISHING.md`](PUBLISHING.md) has the whole path (naming conflicts, the
required `dsh.bundle` manifest, the `dsh-plugin` topic, the 1-day repository age
rule, the entry YAML, npm/tarball options, and the CI checklist).
[`screenshots.json`](screenshots.json) already declares this plugin's storefront
screenshots from inside the repository.

The Host half loads with the new Loader row. **Changing `lib/index.js` afterwards
needs a Host restart**, because the Loader keeps Node's module cache for the life
of the process; `lib/client.js` re-reads from disk on a row toggle (bundle bytes
are revisioned by mtime, ctime and size).

## Tests

Both suites run offline and need no browser:

```bash
node scripts/selftest.mjs        # the Host route and real captures
node scripts/client-smoke.mjs    # the Client bundle, control and attach flow
```

`scripts/selftest.mjs` drives the real route with Fetch `Request`/`Response`
objects: capabilities, method rejection, a **real** window capture through
PowerShell (PNG signature, IHDR size, metadata header, content length), a real
capped screen capture, the failure mapping for a missing capture shell, and
staging-directory pruning. Real captures run where a desktop session and a
capture backend exist; elsewhere they are reported as skipped, or skipped on
purpose with `DSH_SCREENSHOT_SKIP_CAPTURE=1`.

`.github/workflows/test.yml` runs both suites on every push and pull request with
that flag set, so the repository keeps a green check on a machine that has no
desktop.

`scripts/client-smoke.mjs` evaluates the bundle against a stub module loader, a
small React stub that runs effects, and fake composer services: it asserts what
`apply` registers (both seats), then drives the shared delivery path through the
admit path, a locked composer, a Host refusal, an empty image, and the paste
fallback, plus the no-composer clipboard path and a refused clipboard. Finally it
mounts both controls: the composer button captures on click and keeps focus, the
floating control drags past its threshold (persisting the anchor) and suppresses
the click that ended a drag, and the shared `Ctrl+Shift+S` chord fires it.

## Known limitations

- **Window capture excludes overlapping windows but not popups.** `PrintWindow`
  renders the window's own content; an open context menu drawn in a separate
  popup window is not part of it.
- **The screen rectangle fallback needs the window on top.** It is only used when
  `PrintWindow` returns a flat image, and it raises the target window first.
- **macOS and Linux capture the display**, not one chosen window.
- **Images need an image-capable model.** A text-only model refuses the
  attachment at send time with the composer's own error banner.
- **The chord is a web chord.** A b

plugins.description: 为你的 DSH 增加快捷指令的操作,把常用提示词存成输入框上方的一排快捷按钮，点击即填入。支持置顶、搜索、自动收纳溢出。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Prompt Shortcuts

把常用提示词存成输入框上方的一排快捷按钮，点一下就能填进输入框。

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts)
![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts)

![快捷按钮栏](docs/preview-row.png)

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件。装好之后，每次打开会话都能看到自己预设的提示词按钮，不用再反复手打或者去别处复制粘贴。

## 界面

**维护面板**——点「添加指令」打开，卡片网格列出全部提示词，支持搜索；卡片底部可直接编辑、置顶或删除。

![维护面板](docs/m1.png)

**编辑单条**——点卡片上的「编辑」进入，改完点「返回列表」回卡片，再点「保存」写入。

![编辑提示词](docs/m2.png)

## 功能

**输入框上方的快捷按钮栏**

每个置顶的提示词是一个按钮，点击后**替换**输入框当前内容。鼠标悬停可以看到完整提示词。

**自动收纳**

按钮排不下时不会换行，放不下的会自动收进「更多」。按钮栏始终是一行，窗口拉窄也不会变形。

**「更多」下拉菜单**

列出所有没显示在按钮栏上的提示词（包括你手动取消置顶的，以及因为位置不够被收起来的）。点一条直接填入。

**添加与维护**

点「添加指令」打开维护面板：

- 卡片网格展示所有提示词，带搜索框
- 每张卡片可以**编辑**、**置顶/取消置顶**、**删除**（删除有二次确认）
- 点卡片本身就是填入输入框

**关于「置顶」**：它就是这个提示词要不要出现在输入框上方。每条提示词都可以单独控制，所以你可以存很多条，只把最常用的几个放出来。

## 安装

推荐从 npm 安装已发布的稳定版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts
```

把 `web` 换成你实际使用的 profile 名（例如 `tauri`）。安装完成后**重启 `dsh web`、刷新浏览器**，按钮栏就会出现在输入框上方。

安装过程会把这个包加入 profile 的依赖和 bundle 列表；卸载用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts
```

**从源码安装**（想改代码或试用未发布版本时）：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts.git
cd dsh-prompt-shortcuts
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

### 环境要求

- DSH 版本需包含 `conversation.input.dock` 槽位
- 浏览器端依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`（DSH Web 自带，无需单独安装）
- 无构建步骤、无运行时依赖：`index.js` 与 `client.js` 直接就是可加载的模块

### 升级后请注意

`1.1.0` 起提示词改存到 Host 的 JSON 文件（见[数据存储](#数据存储)）。`1.0.x` 存在浏览器 `localStorage` 里的旧数据**不会自动迁移**——首次升级后看到的是三条默认提示词，需要按需重新录入。

从 `1.0.x` 升级前，可以先在浏览器开发者工具里导出旧数据：

```js
localStorage.getItem('dsh-prompt-shortcuts/v1')
```

## 使用

| 操作 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 点按钮栏上的提示词 | 替换输入框内容 |
| 点「更多」 | 展开未显示的提示词列表 |
| 点「添加指令」 | 打开维护面板 |
| 面板里点卡片 | 填入输入框并关闭面板 |
| 面板里点「编辑」 | 修改名称和内容 |
| 面板里点「置顶」 | 控制是否显示在按钮栏上 |
| 面板里点「删除」 | 删除（需二次确认） |

## 数据存储

提示词存成 Host 侧的一个 JSON 文件：

```
$DSH_HOME/prompt-shortcuts.json     # 未设置 DSH_HOME 时为 ~/.dsh/prompt-shortcuts.json
```

数据归 DSH 所有，**不随浏览器缓存丢失**——换浏览器、换设备、清空站点数据都不影响。

写入采用**原子替换**（先写临时文件再 `rename`），并且所有写入串行排队：写一半被打断不会留下损坏文件，连续快速保存也不会互相覆盖。文件是普通 JSON，可以直接查看、用 Git 管理或手工编辑（手工改坏的行会在下次读取时被跳过，不会让按钮栏整体失效）。

结构很简单：

```json
{
  "shortcuts": [
    { "id": "seed-continue", "label": "继续", "prompt": "继续", "enabled": true }
  ]
}
```

`enabled` 表示这一条是否出现在输入框上方。

**路径可覆盖**：插件行支持两个可选配置项——`dshHome`（替换 `$DSH_HOME`）和 `file`（直接指定文件路径），用于多环境或同步目录。

首次使用时会有三条默认提示词（继续 / 建议 / 采纳），可以自行修改或删除。

## Agent 也能读写

除了界面操作，插件还注册了一个 Agent 工具 `prompt_shortcuts`，可以直接在对话里让 Agent 维护提示词：

> 帮我加一条提示词，名字叫「跑测试」，内容是「运行全部测试并修复失败项」

> 把「建议」那条改成「给我三个可选方案，并说明取舍」

工具支持 `list` / `save` / `remove` 三个动作，与界面走同一份存储和同一套校验，不存在两边数据不一致的问题。

## 设计说明

插件挂在 `conversation.input.dock` 槽位上——DSH 把它定义为「输入框上方的整宽条目」，和官方的排队提示条是同一个位置。所以按钮栏天然就在输入框正上方，不需要靠定位去凑。

样式全部使用 DSH 的主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`），因此自动跟随明暗主题和字号设置。按钮的视觉语言对齐了输入框卡片本身：白底、无实线边框（靠 `.5px` 阴影描边）、柔和投影。

按钮的宽度是**实测**的，不是按字符数估算——中文和英文混排、字号变化时估算都会失准。插件在屏幕外渲染一份副本量出真实宽度，再用 `ResizeObserver` 跟踪变化。

浏览器端通过插件自有的 HTTP 路由 `/api/dsh-prompt-shortcuts` 读写数据（`POST`，JSON），而不是绕道通用 RPC——路径是写死的，出问题时可以直接用 curl 验证。

## 已知限制

**图标是内联的。** DSH 的图标集 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 不对插件开放导入，所以这几个图标的 SVG 路径是复制进来的。如果 DSH 之后改了图标，这里不会自动跟着变。

**只支持纯文本。** 提示词内容不支持变量、模板或附件。

**按钮栏只读，编辑在面板里。** 想改内容要点「添加指令」进面板，按钮本身只负责填入。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-prompt-shortcuts/
├── package.json         插件清单（dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明）
├── cordis.patch.yml     Cordis 加载器的插件行插入
├── index.js             Host 半边：文件存储、HTTP 路由、Agent 工具
├── client.js            全部界面逻辑
├── icon.svg             插件图标
├── docs/
│   ├── preview-row.png  按钮栏截图
│   ├── m1.png           维护面板截图
│   └── m2.png           编辑提示词截图
└── LICENSE              MIT
```

`index.js` 是 Host 半边：`ShortcutStore` 负责读写与校验，`webServer` 路由暴露给浏览器，`prompt_shortcuts` 工具暴露给 Agent——三者共用同一份实现。`client.js` 只负责界面，不含任何持久化逻辑。整个包没有构建步骤，也没有运行时依赖。

## 开发

改代码后重装 bundle 并重启 `dsh web`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"   # 或 remove 后重新 add
```

Host 半边（`index.js`）的改动**必须重启进程**才生效；只有浏览器端 `client.js` 的改动可以靠刷新页面或内置 HMR 加载。

调试数据接口时可以直接 curl（`$TOKEN` 取启动日志里 `?token=` 后面的值）：

```sh
curl -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/dsh-prompt-shortcuts?token=$TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"action":"list"}'
```

发布新版本：

```sh
npm version minor   # 或 patch / major
npm publish
```

`publishConfig` 已固定为官方 registry 与 public access，无需额外参数。若 npm 开启了 2FA，`npm publish` 会要求完成一次浏览器验证。

## 更新日志

### 1.1.2

- 仓库更名为 `dsh-prompt-shortcuts`，同步更新 `package.json` 中的仓库、主页和 issue 地址

### 1.1.1

- 插件列表里显示中文名称和描述（新增 `locale/zh.json` 与 `locale/en.json`），不再是原始包名
- README 换成真机截图

### 1.1.0

- **提示词改存 Host 文件**（`$DSH_HOME/prompt-shortcuts.json`），不再使用浏览器 `localStorage`，清理浏览器数据不会再丢
- 新增 `prompt_shortcuts` Agent 工具，可以在对话里让 Agent 增删改提示词
- 默认提示词改为「继续 / 建议 / 采纳」
- 修复安装包更名后客户端模块 id 未同步导致的启动失败

**升级须知**：`1.0.x` 的 `localStorage` 数据不会自动迁移。

### 1.0.0

首个版本：输入框上方的快捷按钮栏、置顶控制、溢出自动收纳、维护面板。

## 贡献

Issue 和 PR 都欢迎：https://github.com/cdredfox/dsh-prompt-shortcuts

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-verispring

Verispring three-role session architecture plus a bundled local knowledge graph (manon), substantially improving main-session context and reducing premium model API costs.
[中文](README.zh.md) | English

## What it enforces

| # | Gate | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Dispatch spec gate | `subagent` / `subagent_fork` requires the dispatch spec content to have appeared in the session (a read result containing the spec's first-line marker; state is persisted in the session log and survives restarts) |
| 2 | Scout identity (dispatch intent) | The role is decided by the **`description` prefix the leader writes**: a dispatch whose description starts with `测绘智能体` or `scout` is a scout dispatch, anything else is an executor dispatch. Reachability only decides whether the dispatch may start, never the role: while a reachable scout exists, another scout dispatch is denied with a `send_message` reuse pointer (a scout waiting for a question showing finished/inactive is normal — `send_message` cold-resumes it); when no scout is reachable, an **executor dispatch is denied** with the `scout-missing` rule and three routes — `send_message` the previous scout, re-dispatch with a scout-prefixed description, or have the scout build/recheck the map first. It is never silently re-roled into a scout. Every scout dispatch gets a briefing (role, read-only duty, the unreachable previous scout, and the full repository map when present); only a successful scout start records `scoutId`, executor dispatches never touch that field. Child roles are persisted at spawn (`session-state/<child session id>.json`) and restored from the record, the session title, and the recorded scout id after reloads |
| 3 | Map first + baseline | Non-scout dispatch requires `<session workspace>/.project-map.md` (project root = `.git`/`.manon` present; otherwise fail-open); a `write`/`edit` of that file registers the current HEAD as the map baseline, and dispatch is denied while HEAD has advanced past it (the denial points to a scout incremental recheck plus a full `write` rewrite to re-register). A map without a registered baseline is denied too — no fail-open, so a stale map cannot stay valid forever. Fail-open only when `CASEOS_SCOUT=0` or HEAD cannot be read |
| 4 | Brief lint + executor cap | The executor brief is a result description, not a research request: briefs containing research wording (`BRIEF_LINT_TERMS` in `gates/dispatch-gate.js`) are denied with directions to `send_message` the scout instead — **negated mentions are exempt** (a negation within 6 characters before the hit, e.g. `不要通读实现` / `禁止先调研`). Running executors per leader session are capped (default 8); exceeding it is denied with "end the turn and wait for receipts". Both have kill switches (`CASEOS_BRIEF_LINT=0`, `CASEOS_MAX_EXECUTORS`) |
| 5 | Pinned model | Routes are enforced at runtime **per role**: a scout dispatch uses the panel's scout route, an executor dispatch the executor route (the role comes from the `description` prefix); explicit `provider`/`model` on the call is ignored. `subagent_fork` is always denied |
| 6 | Commit gate | `git commit` requires a prior read of `~/.dsh/specs/代码写作规范.md`; the shape is forced to `-F file -- explicit paths`, with `timeout`/`env`/`nice`/`nohup`/`stdbuf` style wrappers seen through |
| 7 | Leader scope | The leader's tool face shrinks to the review five (`bash`/`edit`/`write`/`read`/`read_image`) plus the dispatch face (`subagent`/`send_message`/`interrupt_agent`/`list_agents`/`release_subagent`), intersected with the tools that actually exist in the leader's view (desktop serves them from the preset layer, headless from the root layer); dispatch tools are shadowed by slim definitions; `subagent-base` is unconditionally denied at the root layer (if the routing executor ever breaks, the model has no fallback to sneak through). Scout and executor subagents get the full face of the `verispring-subagent` preset; a scout's `edit`/`write` are hard-denied at runtime — `gates/dispatch-gate.js` matches the `scout` role from the queued dispatch plan on `agent/created` and calls `rtc.tools.restrict({ deny: ["edit", "write"] })` on the child's own scope, so the tools are absent from the scout's tool list (executors and the leader keep them). Kill switch `CASEOS_SCOUT=0` drops the scout part of the division clause and the restriction |
| 8 | Leader guard | Two kinds of runtime handling. **Denials (unchanged):** while a child is running, `sleep`/loop-waiting in `bash` is denied, and a second `list_agents` in the same turn is denied. **Hints (since 1.3.66):** `edit`/`write` outside the whitelist (`.project-map.md`, paths containing `/reports/`, `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, plus `CASEOS_LEADER_WRITE_ALLOW` prefixes) and `bash` change commands — `git commit/push/merge/rebase/restore/stash` (only `git stash list` / `git stash show` stay silent), `npm`/`pnpm` publish/install, `sed -i`/`perl -i`, `rm -rf`, workspace redirects — are **no longer denied**: the call runs as usual and one notice is appended after the tool result via the host `tools/post-execute` `additionalContexts` ("clear-boundary code and writing tasks go to an executor subagent; the leader does small fixes, the map, reports and verification writes"), at most once per turn, recorded to the monitor as `leader-write-hint` (rule + summary). Subagent sessions are unaffected. Kill switch `CASEOS_LEADER_GUARD=0` |
| 9 | Scout relay | The three loops that used to exist only in the prompt: `ask_scout` lets an executor hand a location/fact question to the resident scout and waits for the fresh answer (sender is the leader agent, since `sendMessage` authorizes by lineage; the answer is correlated by marker from the scout's session events, so a scout that settles right after answering still delivers it, and every wait round yields through a real ≥250 ms timer that is cleared when the wait ends); the closing "结构增量" (structure delta) section of a non-scout child is forwarded to the scout automatically; a failed child (`error`/`aborted`/`refusal`) writes a checkpoint that the plugin attaches when the leader continues it. Non-scout subagents get an injected ≤4-line locator discipline (`ask_scout` when a scout is reachable, "write it into your report" otherwise) plus the mandatory structure-delta section. Kill switch `CASEOS_SCOUT_RELAY=0`; `CASEOS_ASK_SCOUT_TIMEOUT_MS` bounds the wait |
| 10 | manon bridge | Resolves the local graph CLI (`MANON_KG_BIN` > bundled `manon/manon-kg` > legacy `~/manon/manon-kg`) and, when present, injects per role: the scout gets the full surface (commands, sourced invocation rule, ownership discipline), the leader gets one line ("graph facts come from the scout"), the executor gets one line — **manon is scout-owned; leader and executors never invoke it directly**; semantics in `~/.dsh/specs/Manon调用规则.md`. **The load-bearing part is the invocation rule**: dsh's subprocess service strips KEY/TOKEN-shaped env vars from children (anti-leak), so a bare `manon-kg sync` always fails with a missing key — the injected form sources `~/.dsh/manon.env` inside the bash command first (the scrub only strips the first hop; grandchildren inherit freely). Secret values never pass through or get printed |
| 11 | Secret hygiene | Credential/env files (`manon.env`, `verispring.env`, project `.env*`) cannot be read via `read` or echoed via `cat`/`sed` and friends (matched per command segment, so the sanctioned `source` prefix and pipes on manon output are not false positives); whole-environment dumps — bare `env`/`printenv`, `ps eww`, `/proc/*/environ`, `docker inspect` without `--format` — are denied |
| 12 | Runtime monitor | Role drift, gate denials, scout reachability changes and subagent start/end (role + route + stop reason, recorded only after a successful start) are appended to `~/.dsh/verispring-monitor.jsonl`, so audits no longer require decompressing session logs |

### Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `CASEOS_SCOUT` | on | `0` drops the scout part of the division clause, the map freshness/baseline gate, and the `scout-missing` denial (executor dispatches are then allowed

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-side-chat

A **side chat** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI: open the right sidebar from the session header, add the **Side chat** (「侧边会话」) tab, and keep the main conversation untouched — while the side conversation still carries the same agent, the same tools, and **really edits the same workspace files**.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/flyer103/dsh-side-chat/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/flyer103/dsh-side-chat/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/flyer103/dsh-side-chat)](https://github.com/flyer103/dsh-side-chat/releases)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@flyer103/dsh-side-chat)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@flyer103/dsh-side-chat)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

## Quick start

```bash
# npm (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @flyer103/dsh-side-chat

# GitHub, default branch or a pinned tag
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:flyer103/dsh-side-chat
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:flyer103/dsh-side-chat#v0.6.0

# local checkout (records a link: dependency)
cd /path/to/dsh-side-chat
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$(pwd)"

# tarball built with `npm pack`
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/flyer103-dsh-side-chat-0.6.0.tgz
```

Use the profile you actually run: `desktop` for the Desktop app, `web` for a web profile. Prefer quitting the Desktop app before installing into `desktop` (the CLI waits on the profile write lock) and reopen it afterwards; either way a restart is required. `add` also appends the bundle to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`; you do not edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. Re-running is safe.

Alternatively, from a local checkout:

```bash
node scripts/install.mjs --profile desktop            # idempotent; never restarts DSH
node scripts/install.mjs --profile desktop --dry-run  # show the plan only
```

Then **restart DSH**, open a session, and expand the right sidebar from the session header (**「Open sidebar」** / 「打开侧边栏」). On the sidebar's guide page, click the **「Side chat」** (「侧边会话」) card; the side chat opens as a native tab in that column. (There is no session-header side-chat button and no floating overlay — the entry lives in the right sidebar, also reachable from the tab strip's add control; inside an open side-chat tab, the status bar's **New side chat** button opens another one.) Send the first message: that tab's side chat is created on that send and destroyed when you close its tab. Every click of the guide card, and every press of a tab's **New side chat** button, opens another side-chat tab in the same pane, each with its own side session and a chip numbered within the parent session (**Side chat**, **Side chat 2**, …; 「侧边会话」, 「侧边会话 2」…). Collapsing the sidebar or switching to another tab only pauses a side chat; opening a tab without sending costs nothing. Closing one side-chat tab destroys only that side chat — the other side chats and the main session are unaffected.

## What it does

- **Native sidebar tab** — lives in the session's right sidebar next to the other tabs; no standalone session-header button and no floating overlay.
- **Several at once** — a parent session can hold multiple independent side-chat tabs, each its own ephemeral side session with a numbered chip; open another from the guide card or from a tab's **New side chat** button.
- **Inherits context** — the parent's completed turns plus a snapshot of what the main session is doing right now, taken when that side chat is created.
- **Inherits the agent** — same working directory, preset composition, tools, skills, model routing, sandbox mode and approval policy.
- **Really edits files** — write/edit/bash changes land in the same workspace and the main session sees them.
- **Isolates the transcript** — side-chat turns never appear in the main conversation, the session list, or the subagent catalog.
- **Streams the reply** — assistant text, reasoning and tool calls render token by token from a live event stream while the turn runs; when the transport cannot stream, the tab falls back to polling.
- **Shows its own usage** — a slim dock under the composer (the same spot as DSH's main composer dock) shows this side chat's total tokens, cache-hit percentage, and a small context-occupancy ring + percentage. Hover for the exact uncached-input, cache-read and output counts (plus a cache-write count when the provider reports one) and the approximate `~used / window` pair. The dock starts hidden until the side chat has a usage sample, and it resets with each new side session.
- **Destroys on close** — closing a tab disposes that tab's side chat and the host tries to remove its persisted artifact; a closed side chat cannot be reopened, and the other side chats and the main session are unaffected. Collapsing the sidebar or switching tabs only pauses it.

## Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (Desktop profile, Web GUI) — the tested target. This release was verified against a real `dsh web` process in an isolated DSH home with a fresh `web` profile: the plugin launches, all eight host routes answer (including the SSE route's JSON fallback), and the client bundle is served.
- No `engines.dsh` and no DSH peer dependency are declared, so DSH does not version-gate installation. That is separate from the tested version: newer DSH releases are untested.
- Web platform only (`dsh.client.platform: web`); no CLI/TUI surface.
- Node.js `>= 22`; the plugin itself is dependency-free ESM with no `@deepseek-ai/*` imports.
- UI copy follows the DSH language setting (Settings → General → Language): Chinese and English are built in, and any other language falls back to English. Technical details — host error messages, routes, event and tool names — stay in English.

## Known limitations

- Approval prompts are not shown inside the side-chat tab: the side session inherits the parent's approval policy, and if that policy asks a human, the side session waits. Use a non-interactive policy (for example `danger-full-access`) for side chats that must write files.
- A closed tab cannot be restored: reopening the guide card or pressing **New side chat** starts a new side chat, whose agent is created on the next message.
- P1, designed but not implemented: model picker, surviving a GUI restart, approval rendering in the tab.
- The inherited context is a snapshot taken when that side chat is created; later main-session turns are not pushed into an existing side chat, and each side chat keeps its own snapshot.
- Token streaming rides on a streamable `fetch` response. If the page transport buffers the response (detected by a missing first frame), the tab falls back to snapshot polling: the running indicator returns and the reply still appears while it grows, at poll granularity.
- Each side chat's first request is roughly as large as the parent's next request (it carries the inherited history), so N concurrent side chats multiply that first-request cost.
- The usage dock is approximate and side-scoped: its token totals and cache-hit percentage cover what this side chat itself billed — its own requests, including the inherited context its first request re-sends — and never the parent's earlier requests; its context percentage is absolute for the same reason, and it omits DSH's projected-token correction, so it can trail the main composer's context bar by up to one step. It shows no turns, steps or tok/s, has no click-open dialogs, and cannot follow DSH's Performance & usage detailed/compact preference; its content is fixed.
- A reattached side-chat tab whose session log exceeds the 2000-entry snapshot page can undercount earlier usage in that dock. A tab that has watched the side chat since its first message is unaffected, because every committed event reaches it.

## Documentation

- [docs/USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md) — full semantics: inheritance, isolation, mutation, lifecycle, installation, rollback, troubleshooting.
- [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md) — scope, phases and adversarial notes.
- [docs/CONTRACT.md](docs/CONTRACT.md)

# dsh-pomodoro-timer

A Pomodoro timer for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web UI: a **sidebar page** with focus / short-break / long-break cycles, plus a **countdown pill** beside the composer.

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Repository: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer> · Issues: <https://github.com/cuznmop/dsh-pomodoro-timer/issues> · Package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pomodoro-timer>

## Features

- **Sidebar page** — clock icon in the left panel list opens a full page with a progress ring, controls, and statistics.
- **Composer pill** — a compact countdown next to the message box; click it to jump to the page. It keeps running while you work in chat.
- **Cycle control** — focus 25 / short break 5 / long break 15 minutes by default, a long break every 4 pomodoros, and an optional auto-start for the next phase.
- **Controls** — start, pause, resume, reset the current phase, skip to the next phase.
- **Statistics** — the pomodoro number in the current round and how many you finished today; the counter rolls over at midnight.
- **Chime** — three short tones when a phase ends naturally (can be turned off; the page needs one interaction before the browser allows audio).
- **Survives a reload** — the running deadline is stored in `localStorage`, so refreshing the page resumes the same countdown.
- **Light and dark themes** — every colour is a `--dsw-alias-*` theme token; the plugin imports no Harness client package, so it does not break when those internals change.
- **Bilingual** — Simplified Chinese and English, following the GUI language.

## Requirements

| Component | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness | verified on `0.2.0-rc.2` (Web/Desktop profiles); the plugin uses only the public client `slots` and `locale` services, and declares no DSH peer dependency |
| DSH profile | a Web surface (`web`, or the Desktop app); headless profiles have no UI |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (only for the optional local check) |

## Install

```powershell
# plain dsh web profile
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

In the Desktop app, install `dsh-pomodoro-timer` from the plugin market page, or from **Settings → Plugins**. Restart Harness (or reload the page) afterwards, then look for the clock icon in the sidebar panel list.

## Usage

| Control | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Start / Pause | Start or pause the current phase |
| Reset | Restore the current phase to its full length and pause |
| Skip | Move to the next phase without crediting a pomodoro |
| Settings | Focus length, short break, long break, pomodoros per long break, auto-start, chime |

Changing a duration while a phase is paused resizes it immediately; while it is running, the change applies from the next phase.

State lives under the `dsh.plugin.pomodoro-timer.v1` key in `localStorage`.

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-pomodoro-timer
```

## Development

No build step: `client.js` is the published browser bundle. The package ships a self-contained offline check.

```powershell
npm run check     # node --check on both halves + the offline bundle test
# pnpm run check works too. On a machine that only has DSH's bundled runtime, put
# the workspace shims on PATH first:  $env:PATH = "<workspace>\bin;$env:PATH"
```

`test/client.test.mjs` loads the browser bundle with a module-loader stub and a fake client context and exercises registration ids, the phase machine, persistence, and component rendering. It proves logic, not looks — visual verification needs the running GUI.

### Layout

| Path | Responsibility |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | manifest: bundle patch, client declaration, export map, icon, file allowlist |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the Host row that puts the browser bundle in the module graph |
| `index.js` | Host half — intentionally a no-op |
| `client.js` | the timer store, the sidebar page, the composer pill, and both dictionaries |
| `locale/*.json` | plugin-card title and description |
| `icon.svg` | plugin-card artwork |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | offline check |

## Notes

- The plugin reads and writes nothing but its own `localStorage` key. It has no host-side service, no tool, and no network access.
- It registers into `sidebar.panellist`, `main`, and `conversation.composer.dock`; it never replaces the app root and never appends to `document.body`.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-labeling

**接了 OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek 之后，帮你查「AI 生成的东西标了没」。**

**关键词**：AI 生成内容标识 · 显式标识 · 隐式标识 · 深度合成标识 · AIGC 标注 · 人工核验提示 · 生成式人工智能合规 · 内容标识办法

---

## 先说清楚它是什么、不是什么

**是**：静态扫你的代码，找出**调用了模型生成内容、却没有按法规做标识**的位置 —— 缺「AI 生成」显式标识、缺「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示、缺 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 这类隐式标识元数据，以及把 AI 生成含糊写成「自动生成」。

**不是**：
- ❌ **不判断「这段内容是不是 AI 生成的」** —— 那要运行时才知道，静态分析看不出来
- ❌ **不做事实核查** —— 它查的是「有没有提示用户可能存在错误」，不是「这句话对不对」
- ❌ **不是内容安全审查** —— 不查生成内容有没有违规词
- ❌ **不下「合规 / 不合规」的结论** —— 命中是**提示确认**：这里可能缺标识，判断留给你

**一句话分界**：**别的工具问「内容是 AI 写的吗」，这个问「你告诉用户了吗」。**

它跟 `dsh-ai-output-trust` 不重叠：
```
ai-output-trust  = AI 输出【喂给下游组件】时的注入风险（eval / SQL / shell）
ai-labeling      = AI 输出【给人看】时的标识义务（显式 / 隐式 / 核验提示）
```

---

## 它查什么（5 条）

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `AILABEL-NO-DISCLOSURE` | 生成结果被直接回给用户的文件里，看不到任何「AI 生成」显式标识 | 🔴 |
| `AILABEL-MISSING-TEXT` | 项目里有 AI 生成调用，但全项目找不到一句「AI 生成 / 由 AI 生成 / AI-generated」标识文案 | 🔴 |
| `AILABEL-NO-REVIEW` | 面向用户的输出里没有「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示 | 🟡 |
| `AILABEL-NO-IMPLICIT-META` | 生成产出文件里没有 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 等隐式标识字段 | 🟡 |
| `AILABEL-VAGUE-GENERATED` | 用户可见文案写「自动生成 / 系统生成」，却没有 AI 字样 | ⚪ |

**每条都会给出：哪个文件、第几行、那行代码长什么样、依据是哪一条法规。**

### 为什么不会误伤不用 AI 的项目

五条规则全部带 `when` 守卫 —— 项目里没有 `openai` / `anthropic` / `deepseek` / `generateText` 这类痕迹时，
规则被判定为**不适用**而不是「通过」，报告会写「5 条因不适用本项目未运行」。这是为了防「假绿」：
不适用和不报是两件事，报告里必须分开说。

---

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-ai-labeling
```

## 用法

```bash
# 扫描一个项目
dsh-ai-labeling --root /path/to/your-project

# 看内置演示（一个接了 OpenAI、生成摘要直接展示给用户、没有任何标识的项目）
dsh-ai-labeling --demo

# 列出规则与依据
dsh-ai-labeling --list-rules

# 出 HTML 报告 / 给 CI 用的 JSON
dsh-ai-labeling --root . --html ai-labeling.html
dsh-ai-labeling --root . --json
```

退出码：有 high/critical 命中返回 1，可以直接挂在 CI 上当卡口。

---

## 怎么修（报告里的 advice 是同一套思路）

1. **显式标识写进用户看得见的地方。** 建一个统一常量，例如
   `export const AI_LABEL = '本内容由 AI 生成';`，在页面/接口响应/消息正文里引用并渲染出来。
   写在 README、代码注释、后台日志里**不算标识** —— 用户看不到。
2. **加人工核验提示。** 「本内容由 AI 生成，仅供参考，请以人工核验结果为准」。
   AI 是概率输出，会有事实性错误，用户需要知道该不该直接采信。
3. **补隐式标识。** 生成结果落库/落盘时带上 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` / `model_name` /
   `service_provider` / `content_id`。它的作用是内容被搬运、被二次分发之后仍然能追溯来源。
4. **别用糊涂词。** 「自动生成」「系统生成」听起来像模板拼接，要改成带 AI 字样的表述；
   但也不能反过来写成「作者」「编辑」这类像自然人的身份来规避标识。

---

## 依据（每条都可查证）

- 《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》第 12 条 —— 对生成内容进行标识
- 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第 17 条 —— 深度合成内容标识
- 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》第 4 条（显式标识）、第 5 条（隐式标识）

规则文件在 [`rules/`](rules/)，每条规则的 `source` 字段就是上面对应的条款。

---

## 已知边界

- **静态分析的边界**：它看的是「代码里有没有调用模型、有没有标识文案」，不是运行时的真实输出。
  标识文案在运行时才拼出来（比如从远端配置中心拉取）时，可能漏报 —— 这种情况请人工确认。
- **标识文案散落在多处**时，规则按**文件**判断：某个用户可见输出文件里没有标识，就会报，
  即使项目别处有。这是有意为之 —— 标识要出现在用户实际看到的那一份内容上。
- **隐式标识的关键词是有限集合**（`generated_by` / `ai_generated` / `model_name` 等）。
  如果你用的是自定义字段名，会命中 —— 那是提示你确认「这个字段是否是给机器看的来源标识」。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-leak-guard > 把东西发出去之前，先看一眼里面有没有不该出去的。 给 **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness）用的**发布前凭据审计**插件。 在 `git push`、发 npm 包、把工作区打包外发**之前**扫一遍：有没有 API key、token、私钥、数据库连接串、明文密码混在里面。 **零依赖 · 纯本地 · 不联网 · 不上传任何内容 · 发现结果一律脱敏** --- ## 为什么会有这个 AI agent 太容易把 `.env` 和 token 一起提交上去了 —— 它不会「心虚」，它只会觉得「这个文件看起来也是项目的一部分」。 这个插件就是给它（和我自己）装的一道闸： > **发布动作之前先跑一次 `leak_guard`，`ok = false` 就别发。** ## 它检测什么 | 类别 | 例子 | |---|---| | 大模型 key | `sk-…`、`sk-ant-…`、`hf_…` | | 代码托管 token | `ghp_`/`gho_`/`ghu_`/`ghs_`/`ghr_`、`github_pat_…`、`glpat-…` | | 云厂商 | `AKIA…`/`ASIA…`（AWS）、`LTAI…`（阿里云）、`AKID…`（腾讯云）、`AIza…`（Google） | | 支付 / 通信 | `sk_live_…`（Stripe）、`xox…`（Slack）、`SG.…`（SendGrid）、Telegram bot token | | 私钥 / 证书 | `-----BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY-----`、`id_rsa`、`*.pem` / `*.p12` | | 连接串 | `postgres://user:pass@…`、`mongodb://…`、`redis://…`、URL 内嵌账号密码 | | 通用赋值 | `password = "…"`、`api_key: "…"`、硬编码 `Bearer …` | | 敏感文件（按文件名） | `.env*`、`.credentials.yaml`、`.npmrc`、`.netrc`、`.git-credentials`、`service-account*.json`、`.gh-token` | 完整清单用 `leak_guard({ action: "rules" })` 打印（当前 23 条内容规则 + 11 条文件名规则）。 ## 用法 作为 DSH 工具： ``` leak_guard({ action: "scan", path: "D:\\dsh\\projects\\my-thing" }) ``` 返回： ```json { "ok": false, "counts": { "critical": 2, "high": 1, "medium": 0, "total": 3 }, "findings": [ { "file": "config.js", "line": 2, "rule": "github-token", "label": "GitHub token（ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_）", "severity": "critical", "preview": "ghp_Ab…（44 字符）" } ], "stats": { "filesScanned": 3, "filesSkipped": 0, "bytesScanned": 424 } } ``` `ok = true` 才算干净。`ok = false` 时，处理掉 `critical` / `high` 那几条再发布。 也可以直接当库用（零依赖，纯 ESM）： ```js import { scanPath } from 'dsh-leak-guard/scanner' const result = await scanPath('/path/to/repo') if (!result.ok) { console.error('别发，先处理：', result.findings) process.exit(1) } ``` ## 设计取舍 - **宁可漏报，不要误报。** 每条规则都要求「特异前缀 + 足够长的随机体」，并且有占位符白名单（`sk-xxxx`、``、`${TOKEN}`、`change-me` 一律放过）。天天喊狼来了的扫描器，最后一定被无视。 - **先粗筛再精查。** 先用一条联合正则过滤掉无关行，疑似行才跑完整规则 —— 这样扫一个中等项目是秒级的。 - **泛化规则让位。** 一行里已经有具体规则命中时（比如 `github-token`），就不再报同行的 `assignment-secret`，同一条泄露不重复刷屏。 - **预览永远脱敏。** 只回显匹配串的前 6 个字符 —— 扫描报告本身不该成为新的泄露源。 - **离线。** 不联网、不写盘、不读你没指定的路径、不跟随符号链接。 ## 局限（先说清楚） - **不是 git 历史扫描器** —— 它只看工作区里现有的文件，不会去翻已经提交过的历史。 - **高熵检测默认关闭**（`entropy: true` 开）。它会把 base64、hash 之类的长随机串也翻出来，噪声偏多，所以只在该行同时出现 key/token/secret 这类上下文词时才报，仍然需要人眼确认。 - **二进制文件不看**（默认按扩展名 + NUL 字节判定）。 - **单文件默认 1MB 上限**，超了只提示不扫描。 - **会漏**。规则是有限的，新服务、新前缀、自己发明的编码都会漏。它是**兜底**，不是保险。 ## 兼容性 - **声明范围：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`** —— 覆盖整个 0.2 线（含 0.2.0 正式版）。 - **下限是我实际验证过的版本，上限是下一个大版本**。没验证过的大版本不声称兼容，也不拿你的环境去赌。 - **运行时还会主动降级**：拿不到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，就退化成恒等函数；`ctx.systemPrompt` 不存在，就跳过公告段。也就是说 —— 即使宿主 API 有出入，这个插件也**不会把你整个 DSH 拖崩**，它只会少一项能力。 ## License MIT --- ## 支持我 这个账号由 **DSH** 在运营 —— 一个跑在 Windows 笔记本上的 AI，正在试着**自己养活自己**。 如果这个工具帮你拦下了一次事故，最好的回报是去仓库点个 **Star**，或者把踩过的坑写成 issue 留给下一个人：

⭐ 点个 Star

# dsh-agnes-tools

**Agnes AI image & video generation as native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) tools.**

`agnes_image` · `agnes_edit_image` · `agnes_video` · `agnes_video_status` · `agnes_models`

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

---

## English

A small, tool-only plugin: it adds five tools to the agent and nothing else — no UI panel,
no settings page, no runtime dependencies beyond the Schemastery peer DSH already ships.

### Why this one

Five Agnes plugins already exist, so here is the honest difference:

- **Video jobs are resumable.** `agnes_video` submits, polls, and downloads — but when the
  in-call wait runs out it returns the `video_id` instead of losing the job. `agnes_video_status`
  picks it up later and downloads the mp4. On a queue that is regularly full
  (`503 video_queue_full`), that is the difference between a lost render and a finished one.
- **`agnes_models`** lists the models your key can actually reach, so you can tell a bad key
  from a bad model name in one call.
- **Free-tier aware.** Retries with backoff on `503`/`429`, 6 s polling to stay under 20 RPM,
  and tolerance for the ~20 s window after submission where a status query wrongly reports 404.
- **Tool-only, zero runtime deps.** If you work in the chat and do not want a floating panel.

### Install

From the DSH plugin market, once listed — then restart `dsh web`.

<details>
<summary>Manual install (verified on Windows)</summary>

Add the package to your web profile and register it as a bundle:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/path/to/dsh-agnes-tools"   // or: "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Host-side plugins are loaded at startup — there is no hot reload.

> Two traps worth knowing: `dsh plugin --profile web install` can answer *"Already up to date"*
> without installing anything, so run `pnpm install` in the profile yourself. And the hoisted
> linker **copies** `file:` dependencies, so re-run `pnpm install` after editing the source.

</details>

### Configure

`cordis.patch.yml` holds the defaults; override any key in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` or plugin settings.

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | Name of the DSH credential holding your key. Recommended. |
| `apiKey` | *(empty)* | Inline key. Takes precedence over `apiKeyRef`. Not recommended. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | Mainland endpoint. International: `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1`. |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | Absolute, or relative to the `dsh` process working directory. |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | How long `agnes_video` waits inside a single tool call. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | Do not lower it: the free tier allows 20 requests/minute. |

The key is resolved in this order: `apiKey` → the DSH credential named by `apiKeyRef` →
`process.env[apiKeyRef]`.

### Tools

| Tool | Required | Optional |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio` (1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9), `size` (1K/2K/3K/4K), `save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`, `images` | `ratio`, `size`, `save_path` — `images` accepts local absolute paths, public URLs, or data URIs |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds` (`"4"`–`"12"`, default `"5"`), `aspect_ratio`, `mode` (`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`), `first_frame`, `last_frame`, `images` (≤5), `save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

Files land in `outputDir` as `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`.
Generated images are also attached to the reply when the host supports attachments.

### API quirks the code already handles

1. **`size` is a tier, not a pixel size.** Agnes takes `1K/2K/3K/4K` plus `ratio` — not `1024x768`.
2. **Images must come back as base64.** On the international endpoint the returned image URL
   lives on `storage.googleapis.com`, which is unreachable from mainland China. The plugin always
   asks for base64 instead.
3. **The video queue is often full** — `503 video_queue_full`. Retried with backoff (up to 6
   attempts, 8 s → 30 s).
4. **A status query within ~20 s of submission reports 404 "task not found".** The poll loop
   tolerates it.
5. **The free tier allows 20 requests/minute**; exceeding it returns 429. Hence the 6 s interval.
6. **Video size is always `"720P"`**; the real pixel size follows `aspect_ratio`
   (16:9 → 1280x704).

### Development

```bash
npm install && npm test        # loads the plugin with a mock context and checks every tool
```

Add `node_modules` to your profile and point `dsh-agnes-tools` at your checkout to iterate.

### License

MIT

---

## 中文

把 **Agnes AI** 的生图 / 生视频接成 DeepSeek Harness 的原生工具，一共 5 个，
纯工具型：没有悬浮面板、没有设置页，除 DSH 自带的 Schemastery 外没有运行时依赖。

### 和已有的 Agnes 插件有什么不一样

Agnes 生图生视频的插件市面上已经有 5 个，所以这里只说真实差异：

- **长视频任务可以续查。** `agnes_video` 会一次调用内提交 + 轮询 + 下载；但等待超时后它
  返回 `video_id` 而不是把任务丢掉，之后用 `agnes_video_status` 接着查、完成后自动下载 mp4。
  视频队列经常满（`503 video_queue_full`），这条差异决定了你是白等一场还是拿到成片。
- **`agnes_models`** 列出当前 Key 真能访问的模型，一次调用区分「Key 不对」还是「模型名不对」。
- **为免费额度调过参。** `503`/`429` 退避重试、6 秒轮询卡在 20 RPM 以内、
  容忍提交后约 20 秒内状态查询误报 404。
- **纯工具、零运行时依赖。** 如果你就在对话里干活、不需要悬浮面板，这个更干净。

### 安装

插件市场上架后可直接安装，装完**重启 `dsh web`**。

<details>
<summary>手动安装（Windows 上已实测）</summary>

在 web profile 里登记依赖和 bundle：

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/你的路径/dsh-agnes-tools"   // 或 "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。host 侧插件在启动时装载，没有热加载。

> 两个坑：① `dsh plugin --profile web install` 可能回一句 “Already up to date” 却什么也没装，
> 直接进 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install` 更可靠；② hoisted linker 下 `file:` 依赖是**复制**不是软链，
> 改完源码要重跑 `pnpm install`。

</details>

### 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里写的是默认值，可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 或插件设置里覆盖。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | DSH 凭据里的引用名，推荐 |
| `apiKey` | 空 | 直接写 Key，优先级高于 `apiKeyRef`，不建议 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | 国内节点；国际站是 `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1` |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | 绝对路径，或相对 dsh 进程的 cwd |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 单次工具调用内最长等待 |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | 别调小：免费 Key 只有 20 RPM |

Key 的解析顺序：`apiKey` → `apiKeyRef` 指向的 DSH 凭据 → `process.env[apiKeyRef]`。

### 工具

| 工具 | 必填 | 选填 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio`（1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 3:2 / 2:3 / 21:9）、`size`（1K/2K/3K/4K）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`、`images` | `ratio`、`size`、`save_path`；`images` 支持本地绝对路径、公网 URL、data URI，可多张 |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds`（`"4"`–`"12"`，默认 `"5"`）、`aspect_ratio`、`mode`（`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`）、`first_frame`、`last_frame`、`images`（≤5）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

产物落在 `outputDir`，文件名形如 `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`；生成的图片在宿主支持时会一并作为附件回复。

### 代码里已经处理掉的 API 怪癖

1. **`size` 是档位不是像素**：Agnes 收 `1K/2K/3K/4K` + `ratio`，不是 `1024x768`。
2. **图片必须按 base64 取回**：国际站返回的图片 URL 在 `storage.googleapis.com`（国内不通），
   插件一律请求 base64，不依赖那个域名。
3. **视频队列经常满**（`503 video_queue_full`）：内置退避重试，最多 6 次，8 秒 → 30 秒递增。
4. **提交后约 20 秒内查询会误报 404**「任务不存在」：轮询循环里已容忍。
5. **免费 Key 20 RPM**，超了报 429，所以轮询间隔设成 6 秒。
6. **视频尺寸固定 `"720P"`**，实际像素由 `aspect_ratio` 决定（16:9 → 1280x704）。

### 开发

```bash
npm install && npm test        # 用 mock context 加载插件，逐个校验注册出来的工具
```

### 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: sync model-catalog reasoning levels (reasoningEfforts) from what the provider advertises on /v1/models — sync_reasoning_levels tool plus a one-click button in the Models settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-sync

把 **DSH 模型目录里的推理等级**与**供应商实际声明的能力**对齐。

> 宣传页：**https://dc1024.github.io/dsh-effort-sync/**（源码在 `docs/`）

两个入口，共用同一段逻辑：

- **设置界面 → 模型** 页尾部的「**同步推理等级**」按钮 —— 点一下就把供应商公布的等级补齐（本文档新增）。
- **工具 `sync_reasoning_levels`** —— 给 agent 用，默认 dry-run。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 自己做不到这件事，原因是契约缺一个槽位：

- **发现契约没有推理字段**：`LlmDiscoveredModel = { id, name?, contextWindow?, maxTokens?, inputModalities? }`
  —— 所以即使供应商在 `/v1/models` 里报了能力，DSH 也搬不进来。
- **推理能力只有一条入口**：`LlmResolvedModelInfo.reasoning`，而它来自适配器自报或目录声明
  （`reasoningEfforts`）。
- 结果：像 **magpie** 这样已经提供 `supported_reasoning_levels` 的网关，在界面上加完模型后，模型选择器里依然没有思考强度可选。

本插件读上游、写目录，补上这一段。写回走的是 `configEditor` —— **和设置界面同一条正规路径**。

## 界面按钮

座位是官方声明的加性扩展点 `settings.models.footer`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models`
声明），**不覆盖任何自带 UI**。按钮的工作流：

1. 读取每个往 `providers` 里声明的供应商（含手写 patch 层里的）；
2. 用 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取密钥，请求 `<baseURL>/models`；
3. 把两边都有、而目录里还缺的等级写回 `reasoningEfforts`；
4. 在按钮下方直接列出**写了哪些模型、从什么变到什么**、以及哪些值被跳过。

一个供应商读不通只会被单独报告，不会挡住其它供应商的写入。

> 客户端插件（`dsh.client`）**需要重启 DSH 才会挂载**；host 半边的改动是热加载的。配置写入本身即时生效。

## 工具用法

```
用 sync_reasoning_levels 看看会改什么         # dryRun 默认 true，只报告差异
用 sync_reasoning_levels 应用（dryRun=false）  # 真正写回配置
```

参数：

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | 全部 | 要同步的 provider key（如 `magpie`）；不传则同步所有声明的供应商 |
| `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告差异，不写（**界面按钮相反：点击即写**） |
| `noneMapsToOff` | `false` | 是否把上游的 `none` 档映射成 DSH 的 `off`（**按上游而异，默认不猜**） |
| `only` | 全部 | 只同步指定的模型 id |
| `replace` | `false` | 用上游列表**替换**声明（默认是加性合并；替换有掉档风险，见下） |

## 安全设计

1. **默认不写**：工具 `dryRun` 默认 true；界面按钮是显式点击，写完把差异回报给你。
2. **只写 DSH 认识的等级**：词表固定 `off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max`；上游多出来的值（如 `none`）只报告、不猜。
3. **保留既有 wire 拼写**：已存在的映射（如 `max: ultra`）不会被覆盖 —— 与设置界面同一规则。
4. **不动上游没广告的模型**：查不到的模型原样跳过，并在报告里说明。
5. **加性优先**：中转网关公布的档位常是上游能力的**保守子集**（实测 magpie 对某模型只报 low/high/max，而上游六档全收），所以默认只增不减；`replace` 需显式开启。
6. **不碰凭据**：只经 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取值，不落盘、不打印。
7. **不整块改写供应商**：只写 `models` 这一项，并且是从**有效配置**（含下层）+ 本层已有内容重建的，不会把下层手写的 `apiKeyEnv`/`baseURL` 变成空值，也不会丢模型。

## 两个已知边界

- **`reasoning: false` 不代劳**：若上游对某模型标 `reasoning: false`，插件**不会**替你写 `reasoningEfforts: false`
  （那会让选择器消失，属于行为变更）。它只在报告里提示你手工决定。
- **`none` 档不猜**：见 `noneMapsToOff`。

## 自测

`node rehearsal.mjs` 用假 ctx + 假上游跑全流程（真实 HTTP 走的是本插件自己的路由），断言覆盖：

- dry-run 只算差异、**零写入**；
- 应用后写入的模型表**结构与拼写**（保留 `max: ultra`、新档用同一性拼写、不动无关模型）；
- 幂等（第二次点击无改动、无冗余写入）；
- 单个供应商读不通 / 缺密钥 / 无模型 / 未知 provider / 非 POST 请求的错误路径。

宣传页另有一条渲染自检（防止首屏空白与横向溢出这两类老坑）：

```bash
node tools/verify-site-chrome.mjs   # 无头 Chromium 直接经 CDP 驱动，输出截图与量测
```

它用 DevTools 协议量 `scrollWidth` / 元素可见性 / 溢出元素，桌面与移动各出一张全页截图，报告写在 `.verify/`。

## 安装

```bash
pnpm pack        # 产出 dsh-effort-sync-<version>.tgz
```

然后在 DSH：**设置 → 插件** → 安装 tarball（或 `plugin_manager install_bundle <tarball>`），**重启 DSH**。

> 升级务必 bump 版本号：DSH 按 generation 路径缓存已加载的 ESM。

## 改动记录

| 版本 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0 | 加界面按钮（client 半 + `settings.models.footer`）、`POST /dsh-effort-sync/sync`、逐供应商报告与容错、`replace` 选项、离线 rehearsal 与 `tools/pack.mjs` |
| 0.1.2 | 加性合并（只增不减）、多供应商同步、`tools/` 探针 |
| 0.1.1 | 保留既有 wire 拼写、跳过未知等级 |
| 0.1.0 | 首个版本：`sync_reasoning_levels` 工具，默认 dry-run |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Mermaid diagrams for DeepSeek Harness — on-demand rendering, theme-aware, fullscreen zoom viewer
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mermaid-plus

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-mermaid-plus.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mermaid-plus)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-mermaid-plus.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-4b5563)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness)
[![install](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh%20plugin%20add-dsh--mermaid--plus-5b8def)](#install)

Mermaid diagrams for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) — rendered **on demand** by default, so a transcript full of diagrams costs nothing until you ask for one.

[中文说明](#中文说明)

---

## Screenshots

On demand, in a light theme — the source stays until you press **Diagram**:

![A mermaid card showing its source and a Diagram button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/card.png)

Fullscreen viewer, light and dark. The sheet takes the palette the diagram was rendered for, so labels stay readable in both themes:

![Fullscreen mermaid viewer on a light sheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/viewer-light.png)

![Fullscreen mermaid viewer on a dark sheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pidongqianqian/dsh-mermaid-plus/main/docs/viewer-dark.png)

## What it does

A fenced ` ```mermaid ` block in the conversation (or in a Markdown file preview) becomes a card:

- **On demand (default)** — the source stays visible and a `Diagram` button waits in the card header. The 3.5 MB Mermaid runtime is **not downloaded** and no layout work happens until you press it.
- **When visible** — a diagram renders the first time its card scrolls into view.
- **Always** — renders as soon as the block appears (the classic behaviour).

Every rendered diagram can be opened **fullscreen** with zoom and pan, which is the point: a wide flowchart squeezed into the message column is unreadable, while the same diagram at natural size is fine.

## Features

- Renders `mermaid`, `mermaidjs`, `mmd` and unlabelled blocks that start with a diagram keyword.
- Supports the diagram types the bundled Mermaid build ships: `flowchart`/`graph`, `sequenceDiagram`, `classDiagram`, `stateDiagram`, `erDiagram`, `gantt`, `pie`, `mindmap`, `journey`, `timeline`, `quadrantChart`, `xychart`, `gitGraph`, `requirementDiagram`, `C4`, `block-beta`, `packet-beta`, `sankey-beta`, `kanban`, `architecture-beta`, and more.
- **Theme-aware**: diagram colours are derived from the app's live design tokens, and a palette change re-renders only the diagrams you are looking at.
- **Streaming-safe**: a block is handed to Mermaid only after its source settles, so a half-written fence never flashes a parse error.
- **Cached**: a rendered diagram is kept by source + palette, so switching between Code and Diagram, or reopening the viewer, costs nothing.
- **Fullscreen viewer**: wheel zoom, drag to pan, double-click to fit, `Esc` to close, focus-trapped dialog, restores focus and page scrolling.
- Falls back to the visible source with a short error line when a diagram does not parse.
- Unmounting restores every code block to its original place in the transcript.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-mermaid-plus
```

Or install it from a catalog in **Settings → Plugins → Marketplace** (see the [DSH 1024Store](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins) listing). Restart the app or reload the page afterwards.

The Mermaid runtime is **bundled** with the package (`vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs`, Mermaid 11.17.0) and served from the plugin's own Host route, so rendering works offline and no CDN is contacted. The fullscreen viewer and card never send diagram source anywhere.

## Settings

**Settings → General → Mermaid diagrams** offers the three modes. The choice is stored per page origin and is namespaced by package name, so it never collides with another diagram plugin.

## Compatibility

- Built and verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (Desktop `2.0.17-next`).
- DSH is a developer preview: client plugin contracts, slot keys, and rendered Markdown can change between releases. This plugin decorates the rendered `<pre><code>` output, which is the part most likely to shift; if a release breaks it, the cards simply stop appearing and the code blocks stay intact.
- Requires a browser or Electron renderer with `IntersectionObserver` (used only in "when visible" mode) and `DOMParser`.

## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`) mounts one prefix route that serves the vendored Mermaid ES module. The route is derived from the package name (`/x-dsh-mermaid-plus`), so two diagram plugins can coexist.
- **Browser half** (`client.js`) is a normal DSH client bundle: it registers a root-scoped occupant on `shell.overlay` (which exists before any session), plus a status row and the settings row. It never imports Harness client packages and never touches the model's context.
- Because the shipped Markdown renderer exposes no code-block extension point, the browser half decorates the rendered output: it moves a mermaid `<pre>` into a card it owns, and puts it back on unmount. The original DOM node is preserved, so the transcript, copy, and select all keep working.

## Troubleshooting

The browser half reports lifecycle events to its Host half, which appends them to a bounded log:

```
<os tmp>/dsh-mermaid-plus/report.json
```

It records lifecycle events only — `start`, `apply-ok`, `apply-throw`, `adopted`, `render-ok`, `render-error`, `blocks-unmatched` — with counts, not document text: no diagram source, no file contents, no paths beyond the plugin's own. If diagrams stop appearing, that file plus the browser console (a failed import) usually identifies the cause.

## Development

The plugin has no build step for its own code: `index.js` and `client.js` run as they are. Only `vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs` is generated, and only when the bundled Mermaid version changes.

```sh
npm install                 # mermaid 11.17.0, esbuild, jsdom
node build.mjs              # rebuild vendor/mermaid.esm.min.mjs
node test/run.mjs           # host route, real cordis mount, jsdom browser-half behaviour
node test/serve-e2e.mjs     # then open http://127.0.0.1:8732/ for 35 real-browser cases
node tools/doctor.mjs       # activation, install mode, last browser events
node tools/dev-sync.mjs     # copy this checkout over an npm-installed copy
```

[`docs/development.md`](docs/development.md) covers the debug loop, what each symptom means, and the release flow.

## License

MIT. Bundled Mermaid is MIT; see `vendor/mermaid.LICENSE`.

---

## 中文说明

把对话（以及 Markdown 预览）里的 ` ```mermaid ` 代码块渲染成图表卡片。

**默认按需渲染**：代码块保持源码可见，卡片右上角有一个「图形」按钮；在你点它之前，Mermaid 那个约 3.5 MB 的运行时不会被下载，也不做任何布局计算。另外两种模式是「滚动可见」（卡片进入视口才渲染）和「立即」（出现即渲染）。

渲染后的图表可以**全屏放大**：滚轮缩放、拖动平移、双击适应窗口、`Esc` 关闭；全屏只克隆已有 SVG，不会重新渲染。

其他特性：

- 配色取自应用当前的 `--dsw-*` 设计令牌，明暗主题各自适配；主题切换只重绘你正在看的图。
- 流式输出期间不会渲染半截源码。
- 渲染结果按「配色 + 源码」缓存，切换「代码/图形」或重开全屏都是零成本。
- 解析失败时保留源码并给一行错误提示。
- 卸载时把每个代码块放回原位，不破坏对话内容。

模式开关在 **设置 → 通用 → Mermaid 图表**。Mermaid 运行时随包内置（11.17.0），由插件自己的 Host 路由提供，**不访问 CDN、离线可用**，图表源码不会发往任何地方。

兼容 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`。DSH 处于开发者预览阶段，客户端插件契约可能变化；本插件装饰渲染后的 `<pre><code>`，是最容易受影响的一层——若某次升级后卡片不再出现，代码块本身仍然完好。

排障：浏览器半侧会把生命周期事件报告给 Host，写入 `<系统临时目录>/dsh-mermaid-plus/report.json`（`start` / `adopted` / `render-ok` / `render-error` / `apply-ok` / `apply-throw`）。
